module arithmetic_operations #(parameter total_bits = 32) (
    input CLK,
    input DS,
    input ED,
    input MPYJ,
    input signed [total_bits-1:0] DR,
    input signed [total_bits-1:0] DI,
    output reg signed [total_bits:0] DOR,
    output reg signed [total_bits:0] DOI
);

    reg [2:0] ED_pipe;
    reg [2:0] MPYJ_pipe;
    reg signed [total_bits-1:0] stored_DI;
    reg signed [total_bits-1:0] selected_input;
    reg signed [total_bits:0] shifted_primary_result;
    reg signed [total_bits:0] shifted_primary_result_delayed;

    localparam EXT_WIDTH = total_bits + 16;

    always @(posedge CLK) begin
        // Pipeline ED and MPYJ signals
        ED_pipe <= {ED_pipe[1:0], ED};
        MPYJ_pipe <= {MPYJ_pipe[1:0], MPYJ};

        if (ED) begin
            // Select input and store DI
            selected_input <= DS ? DR : DI;
            if (DS) stored_DI <= DI;

            // Calculate intermediates
            wire signed [total_bits-1:0] intermediate1 = selected_input;
            wire signed [total_bits+3-1:0] intermediate2 = (selected_input << 2) + selected_input;
            wire signed [total_bits-1:0] shift3 = selected_input >>> 3;
            wire signed [total_bits:0] intermediate3 = selected_input - shift3;

            // Sign-extend intermediates
            wire signed [EXT_WIDTH-1:0] ext_intermediate1 = intermediate1;
            wire signed [EXT_WIDTH-1:0] ext_intermediate2 = intermediate2;
            wire signed [EXT_WIDTH-1:0] ext_intermediate3 = intermediate3;

            // Calculate primary result
            wire signed [EXT_WIDTH-1:0] term1 = ext_intermediate2 << 1;
            wire signed [EXT_WIDTH-1:0] term2 = ext_intermediate3 >>> 1;
            wire signed [EXT_WIDTH-1:0] term3 = ext_intermediate1 >>> 6;
            wire signed [EXT_WIDTH-1:0] term4 = ext_intermediate2 >>> 13;
            wire signed [EXT_WIDTH-1:0] primary_result = term1 + term2 + term3 - term4;

            // Calculate shifted results
            wire signed [EXT_WIDTH-1:0] shifted_wide = primary_result >>> 3;
            shifted_primary_result <= shifted_wide[EXT_WIDTH-1 -: total_bits+1];
            shifted_primary_result_delayed <= shifted_primary_result;
        end
    end

    // Update outputs based on pipelined controls
    always @(posedge CLK) begin
        if (ED_pipe[2]) begin
            if (MPYJ_pipe[2]) begin
                DOR <= shifted_primary_result;
                DOI <= -shifted_primary_result_delayed;
            end else begin
                DOR <= shifted_primary_result_delayed;
                DOI <= shifted_primary_result;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
</verilog>

localparam [31:0] THRESH_HIGH_REAL = 32'd200;
localparam [31:0] THRESH_LOW_UART = 32'd50;
localparam [31:0] THRESH_HIGH_UART = 32'd150;
localparam [31:0] THRESH_LOW_DEFAULT = {27'b0, stop};
localparam [31:0] THRESH_HIGH_DEFAULT = 32'd8;

reg ym_pm_prev;

    input [7:0] A,
    input [7:0] B,
    output reg [15:0] P
);

    reg [7:0] a_work, b_work;
    reg [3:0] counter;
    reg [15:0] product;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            a_input_reg <= 8'b0;
            b_input_reg <= 8'b0;
            a_work <= 8'b0;
            b_work <= 8'b0;
            product <= 16'b0;
            P <= 16'b0;
            counter <= 4'b0;

    input RX_Gate,
    input [7:0] EmitDelay,
    input [6:0] Emit_Width,
    output reg TXP,
    output reg TXN
);

// State definitions
localparam IDLE  = 3'd0;
localparam DELAY = 3'd1;
localparam HOLD  = 3'd2;
localparam PHASE1 = 3'd3;
localparam PHASE2 = 3'd4;
localparam PHASE3 = 3'd5;

reg [2:0] state;
reg [6:0] delay_counter; // 7-bit counter for delay phase
reg [8:0] phase_counter; // 9-bit counter for pulse phases (up to 3*127=381 cycles)

always @(posedge Transmit_CLK or negedge RX_Gate) begin
    if (!RX_Gate) begin
        // Asynchronous reset on negative edge of RX_Gate
        TXP <= 1'b1;
        TXN <= 1'b1;
        state <= IDLE;
        delay_counter <= 7'd0;
        phase_counter <= 9'd0;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                // Start delay phase
                TXP <= 1'b1;
                TXN <= 1'b1;
                if (EmitDelay[6:0] == 7'd0) begin
                    // No delay, check EmitDelay[7]
                    if (EmitDelay[7]) begin
                        state <= HOLD;
                    end else begin
                        state <= PHASE1;
                        TXP <= 1'b1;
                        TXN <= 1'b0;
                        phase_counter <= (Emit_Width == 7'd0) ? 9'd0 : (Emit_Width - 1);
                    end

                    state <= DELAY;
                    delay_counter <= EmitDelay[6:0] - 1;
                end

            DELAY: begin

                    // Delay complete
                    if (EmitDelay[7]) begin
                        state <= HOLD;
                        TXP <= 1'b1;
                        TXN <= 1'b1;
                    end else begin
                        state <= PHASE1;
                        TXP <= 1'b1;
                        TXN <= 1'b0;
                        phase_counter <= (Emit_Width == 7'd0) ? 9'd0 : (Emit_Width - 1);
                    end
                end else begin
                    delay_counter <= delay_counter - 1;
                end
            end
            PHASE1: begin
                if (phase_counter == 9'd0) begin
                    state <= PHASE2;
                    TXP <= 1'b0;
                    TXN <= 1'b1;
                    phase_counter <= (Emit_Width == 7'd0) ? 9'd0 : (Emit_Width - 1);
                end else begin
                    phase_counter <= phase_counter - 1;
                end
            end
            PHASE2: begin
                if (phase_counter == 9'd0) begin
                    state <= PHASE3;
                    TXP <= 1'b0;
                    TXN <= 1'b0;
                    phase_counter <= (Emit_Width == 7'd0) ? 9'd0 : ( (Emit_Width * 3) - 1 );
                end else begin
                    phase_counter <= phase_counter - 1;
                end
            end
            PHASE3: begin
                if (phase_counter == 9'd0) begin
                    state <= HOLD;
                    TXP <= 1'b1;
                    TXN <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    phase_counter <= phase_counter - 1;
                end
            end
            HOLD: begin
                // Remain in HOLD until reset
                TXP <= 1'b1;
                TXN <= 1'b1;
            end
            default: state <= IDLE;
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule

    input oflow_in,
    input gate,
    output reg oflow_state = 0

    reg [2:0] gate_history = 3'b0;

            if (gate_history[2]) begin

                oflow_state <= 1'b0;

module restoring_divider (
    input [15:0] dividend,
    input [15:0] divisor,
    output reg [15:0] quotient,
    output reg [15:0] remainder
);

    always @* begin
        reg [15:0] current_rem;
        reg [15:0] current_quo;
        integer i;
        reg [15:0] temp_rem_shifted;
        reg [15:0] temp_sub;

        current_rem = 16'b0;
        current_quo = dividend;

        for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin
            // Shift remainder and quotient, bring down next bit
            temp_rem_shifted = (current_rem << 1) | (current_quo >> 15);
            // Subtract divisor from shifted remainder
            temp_sub = temp_rem_shifted - divisor;

            if (temp_sub[15]) begin // Result is negative, restore
                current_rem = temp_rem_shifted;
                current_quo = (current_quo << 1) | 1'b0;
            end else begin // Result is non-negative, keep subtracted value
                current_rem = temp_sub;
                current_quo = (current_quo << 1) | 1'b1;
            end
        end

        remainder = current_rem;
        quotient = current_quo;
    end

endmodule

9.  The BRAM clock (`bram_porta_clk`) should be connected directly to the system clock (`aclk`).
10. The BRAM reset (`bram_porta_rst`) should be connected directly to the inverse of the system reset (`aresetn`).

module axis_bram_writer #(
    parameter integer AXIS_TDATA_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter integer BRAM_DATA_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter integer BRAM_ADDR_WIDTH = 10
)(
    input wire aclk,
    input wire aresetn,
    output wire [BRAM_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] sts_data,
    output wire s_axis_tready,
    input wire [AXIS_TDATA_WIDTH-1:0] s_axis_tdata,
    input wire s_axis_tvalid,
    output wire bram_porta_clk,
    output wire bram_porta_rst,
    output wire [BRAM_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] bram_porta_addr,
    output wire [BRAM_DATA_WIDTH-1:0] bram_porta_wrdata,
    output wire [(BRAM_DATA_WIDTH/8)-1:0] bram_porta_we
);

// State and control registers
reg state;
localparam IDLE = 1'b0;
localparam ACTIVE = 1'b1;
reg [BRAM_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] addr_counter;

// BRAM control signals
reg [BRAM_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] bram_addr_reg;
reg [BRAM_DATA_WIDTH-1:0] bram_wrdata_reg;
reg bram_we_reg;

// Continuous assignments
assign bram_porta_clk = aclk;
assign bram_porta_rst = ~aresetn;
assign bram_porta_addr = bram_addr_reg;
assign bram_porta_wrdata = bram_wrdata_reg;
assign bram_porta_we = bram_we_reg ? {(BRAM_DATA_WIDTH/8){1'b1}} : 0;
assign sts_data = addr_counter;
assign s_axis_tready = (state == IDLE);

always @(posedge aclk) begin
    if (~aresetn) begin
        state <= IDLE;
        addr_counter <= 0;
        bram_addr_reg <= 0;
        bram_wrdata_reg <= 0;
        bram_we_reg <= 0;
    end
    else begin
        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                bram_we_reg <= 0;
                if (s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready) begin
                    // Capture first data beat
                    bram_wrdata_reg <= s_axis_tdata;
                    bram_addr_reg <= addr_counter;
                    bram_we_reg <= 1'b1;
                    addr_counter <= addr_counter + 1'b1;
                    state <= ACTIVE;
                end
            end
            
            ACTIVE: begin
                bram_we_reg <= 0;
                if (s_axis_tvalid) begin
                    // Write subsequent data beats
                    bram_wrdata_reg <= s_axis_tdata;
                    bram_addr_reg <= addr_counter;
                    bram_we_reg <= 1'b1;
                    addr_counter <= addr_counter + 1'b1;
                end
            end
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule
</verilog>

module WcaRssi (
    input clock,
    input reset,
    input strobe,
    input [11:0] adc,
    output [7:0] rssi
);

    // Compute absolute value of ADC input with special handling for -2048
    wire [11:0] adc_abs = (adc == 12'h800) ? 12'h7FF :
                          (adc[11] ? -adc : adc;

    // 20-bit accumulator with decay and accumulation logic
    reg [19:0] accum;

    input wire CLK,
    input wire ENABLE,
    input wire COUNT18,
    input wire COUNT32,
    output reg RESET_INT,
    output reg DONE,
    output reg EN_BCLK
);

// State encoding definitions
localparam [1:0] RESET_ST   = 2'b00,
                 WAIT_ST    = 2'b01,
                 PROCESS_ST = 2'b10;

// State register with asynchronous reset

        WAIT_ST: begin
            next_state = (COUNT18) ? PROCESS_ST : WAIT_ST;

            DONE = 1'b0;
            EN_BCLK = 1'b0;
        end
        WAIT_ST: begin
            RESET_INT = 1'b0;
            DONE = 1'b0;

            RESET_INT = 1'b0;
            DONE = 1'b1;
            EN_BCLK = 1'b1;
        end
        default: begin
            RESET_INT = 1'b1;
            DONE = 1'b0;

- `SPEED`: A 4-bit output representing the speed (implementation-dependent, but required by the interface).

<verilog>
module quadrature_decoder (
    input CLOCK,
    input RESET,
    input A,
    input B,
    output COUNT_ENABLE,
    output DIRECTION,
    output [3:0] SPEED
);

// Synchronize inputs to clock domain
reg a_meta, a_sync;
reg b_meta, b_sync;

always @(posedge CLOCK or posedge RESET) begin
    if (RESET) begin
        a_meta <= 1'b0;
        a_sync <= 1'b0;
        b_meta <= 1'b0;
        b_sync <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        a_meta <= A;
        a_sync <= a_meta;
        b_meta <= B;
        b_sync <= b_meta;
    end
end

// Track previous synchronized values
reg a_prev, b_prev;

always @(posedge CLOCK or posedge RESET) begin
    if (RESET) begin
        a_prev <= 1'b0;
        b_prev <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        a_prev <= a_sync;
        b_prev <= b_sync;
    end
end

// Detect valid single-bit transitions
wire a_changed = (a_sync != a_prev);
wire b_changed = (b_sync != b_prev);
wire transition_valid = a_changed ^ b_changed; // Exactly one signal changed

// Determine direction using phase relationship
wire direction_val = a_sync ^ b_prev;

// Direction output register
reg direction_reg;

always @(posedge CLOCK or posedge RESET) begin
    if (RESET) begin
        direction_reg <= 1'b0;
    end else if (transition_valid) begin
        direction_reg <= direction_val;
    end
end

// Speed measurement counter
reg [3:0] speed_counter;
reg [3:0] speed_reg;

always @(posedge CLOCK or posedge RESET) begin
    if (RESET) begin
        speed_counter <= 4'b0;
        speed_reg <= 4'b0;
    end else begin
        if (transition_valid) begin
            speed_reg <= (speed_counter < 15) ? speed_counter : 4'b1111;
            speed_counter <= 4'b0;
        end else if (speed_counter < 15) begin
            speed_counter <= speed_counter + 1;
        end
    end
end

// Assign outputs
assign COUNT_ENABLE = transition_valid;
assign DIRECTION = direction_reg;
assign SPEED = speed_reg;

endmodule
</verilog>

    reg [3:0] mk_shift;
    reg [3:0] mk_shift_prev;

    // Data shift register

    reg [15:0] cycle_count;
    localparam CAPTURE_CYCLE = 16; // Cycle to capture length
    reg [15:0] captured_length;

    // Fixed write points (adjust values as needed)
    localparam FIXED_CYCLE_1 = 0;
    localparam FIXED_CYCLE_2 = 16;
    localparam FIXED_CYCLE_3 = 32;
    wire in_fixed_cycle = (cycle_count == FIXED_CYCLE_1) || 
                         (cycle_count == FIXED_CYCLE_2) ||

        if (RST) begin
            data_shift <= 16'b0;
        end else begin
            data_shift <= {data_shift[14:0], DATA_RX};

    end
    assign DATA = data_shift;

    // Cycle counter
    always @(posedge CLK_RX or posedge RST) begin
        if (RST) begin
            cycle_count <= 16'b0;
        end else begin
            if (FRAME_START)
                cycle_count <= 16'b0;
            else
                cycle_count <= cycle_count + 1;

    // Length capture
    always @(posedge CLK_RX or posedge RST) begin
        if (RST) begin
            captured_length <= 16'b0;

            captured_length <= data_shift;

        if (RST) begin
            blocks_after_initial <= 16'b0;
        end else if (FRAME_START) begin
            blocks_after_initial <= 16'b0;
        end else if (periodic_write_en) begin
            blocks_after_initial <= blocks_after_initial + 1;
        end
    end

    assign WRITE = FRAME_START || in_fixed_cycle || periodic_write_en;

endmodule

assign not_empty = ~empty;

For each of the `STAGE` steps, starting from the most significant bits:
1. The current remainder (the upper WIDTH bits of the internal state) is compared against the divisor `b` (zero-extended to WIDTH+1 bits for subtraction).
2. A potential new remainder is calculated by subtracting the zero-extended divisor from the current remainder.
3. If the potential new remainder is non-negative (meaning the current remainder was greater than or equal to the divisor):
    *   The internal state is updated. The upper WIDTH bits become the potential new remainder. 4. If the potential new remainder is negative (meaning the current remainder was less than the divisor):
    *   The potential new remainder is discarded.
    *   The internal state is updated by shifting its entire 2*WIDTH bits content left by one position and appending a '0' as the new least significant bit (this '0' is the quotient bit for this step).

    parameter STAGE = 1
) (

    input [WIDTH-1:0] b,
    input [WIDTH-1:0] remainder_in,
    output [WIDTH-1:0] quotient_out,
    output [WIDTH-1:0] remainder_out
);

reg [2*WIDTH-1:0] state;
integer i;

always @(*) begin
    state = {remainder_in, a};
    for (i = 0; i < STAGE; i = i + 1) begin
        reg [WIDTH:0] subtract_result;
        subtract_result = {1'b0, state[2*WIDTH-1 : WIDTH]} - {1'b0, b};
        if (!subtract_result[WIDTH]) begin
            state[2*WIDTH-1 : WIDTH] = subtract_result[WIDTH-1 : 0];
            state[WIDTH-1 : 0] = {state[WIDTH-1 : 1] << 1, 1'b1};
        end else begin
            state = {state[2*WIDTH-2 : 0], 1'b0};

    S_INHIBIT        = 1,
    S_SEND_START     = 2,
    S_SEND_BITS      = 3,
    S_SEND_PARITY    = 4,
    S_SEND_STOP      = 5,
    S_WAIT_ACK       = 6,
    S_OPERATIONAL    = 7;

reg [2:0] bit_count;
reg tx_parity;
reg [15:0] timer;

reg [3:0] rx_bit_count;
reg rx_parity;

localparam INHIBIT_CYCLES = 5000; // 100µs at 50MHz
localparam CMD_INIT = 8'hFF;

            attention <= 1;
            if (counter < INIT_DURATION) begin
                counter <= counter + 1;

                state <= S_INHIBIT;

                    timer <= 0;

                state <= S_SEND_PARITY;

                timer <= 2;

                state <= S_SEND_STOP;

    input push,
    input pop,

    output almost_empty,

    output almost_full,
    output error,
    output cen,
    output wen,
    output oen,
    output [4:0] addr

parameter numOfRam = 32;
parameter delay = 1.5;
parameter EMPTY = 2'b00;
parameter BETWEEN = 2'b01;
parameter READOUT = 2'b10;
parameter FULL = 2'b11;

reg [1:0] state, next_state;
reg [4:0] head, next_head;
reg [4:0] tail, next_tail;

// Combinational next state and pointer logic
always @(*) begin
    next_state = state;
    next_head = head;
    next_tail = tail;

    case (state)
        EMPTY: begin
            if (push) begin
                next_head = (head + 1) % numOfRam;
                next_state = BETWEEN;
            end
        end
        BETWEEN: begin
            if (push && !pop) begin
                next_head = (head + 1) % numOfRam;
                if (next_head == tail) next_state = FULL;
            end else if (!push && pop) begin
                next_tail = (tail + 1) % numOfRam;
                if (next_tail == head) begin
                    next_state = EMPTY;
                end else if ((next_tail + 1) % numOfRam == head) begin
                    next_state = READOUT;
                end
            end else if (push && pop) begin
                next_head = (head + 1) % numOfRam;
                next_tail = (tail + 1) % numOfRam;
            end
        end
        READOUT: begin
            if (push && !pop) begin
                next_head = (head + 1) % numOfRam;
                next_state = BETWEEN;
            end else if (!push && pop) begin
                next_tail = (tail + 1) % numOfRam;
                next_state = EMPTY;
            end else if (push && pop) begin
                next_head = (head + 1) % numOfRam;
                next_tail = (tail + 1) % numOfRam;
                next_state = READOUT;
            end
        end
        FULL: begin
            if (pop) begin
                next_tail = (tail + 1) % numOfRam;
                next_state = BETWEEN;
            end
        end
    endcase
end

// Sequential logic with delay
always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        state <= #delay EMPTY;
        head <= #delay 5'b0;
        tail <= #delay 5'b0;
    end else begin
        state <= #delay next_state;
        head <= #delay next_head;
        tail <= #delay next_tail;
    end
end

// Status flags
assign empty = (state == EMPTY);
assign full = (state == FULL);
assign almost_empty = (state == READOUT) || ((state == BETWEEN) && ((tail + 1) % numOfRam == head));
assign almost_full = (state == BETWEEN) && ((head + 1) % numOfRam == tail);

// Error detection
assign error = (pop && empty) || (push && full) || ((state == EMPTY || state == FULL) && push && pop);

// Control signals
assign cen = (push && !full) || (pop && !empty);
assign wen = (push && !full);
assign oen = (pop && !empty);

// Address generation
assign addr = (push && !full) ? head : tail;

endmodule
</verilog>

9.  **Current State Output:** The `currentState` output should reflect the current state of the FSM. You need to decide on a 3-bit encoding for the states.

module KeyScanController #(
    parameter DIVIDER = 3
) (
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input start,
    input load,
    input shift,
    output reg [2:0] currentState,
    output reg startTimer
);

    // State encoding
    localparam [2:0]
        IDLE       = 3'b000,
        WAIT_DELAY = 3'b001,
        LOAD_DATA  = 3'b010,
        SHIFT_DATA = 3'b011;

    reg [2:0] next_state;
    reg [31:0] counter;

    // Combinational next state logic
    always @(*) begin
        next_state = currentState;
        case (currentState)
            IDLE: begin
                if (start) next_state = WAIT_DELAY;
            end
            WAIT_DELAY: begin
                if (counter == (DIVIDER - 1)) begin
                    if (load)         next_state = LOAD_DATA;
                    else if (shift)   next_state = SHIFT_DATA;
                    else              next_state = IDLE;
                end
            end
            LOAD_DATA: begin
                if (counter == (DIVIDER - 1)) next_state = WAIT_DELAY;
            end
            SHIFT_DATA: begin
                if (counter == (DIVIDER - 1)) next_state = WAIT_DELAY;
            end
            default: next_state = IDLE;
        endcase
    end

    // Sequential logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            currentState <= IDLE;
            counter <= 0;
            startTimer <= 0;
        end else begin
            currentState <= next_state;

            if (currentState != next_state) begin
                counter <= 0;
            end else if ((currentState == WAIT_DELAY) ||

                if (counter < (DIVIDER - 1)) begin
                    counter <= counter + 1;

                    counter <= 0;

                counter <= 0;

            startTimer <= (currentState == IDLE && next_state == WAIT_DELAY);
        end
    end

module spiSlave #(parameter WIDTH = 8) (

    input SS,
    input SCLK,
    input MOSI,
    input [WIDTH-1:0] byteTX,
    input newTXData,
    output reg MISO,
    output [WIDTH-1:0] byteRX,
    output newSPIData,
    output busy
);

    // Synchronization registers for SCLK and SS
    reg sclk_sync0, sclk_sync;
    reg ss_sync0, ss_sync;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        sclk_sync0 <= SCLK;
        sclk_sync <= sclk_sync0;
        ss_sync0 <= SS;
        ss_sync <= ss_sync0;
    end

    // Edge detection for SCLK and SS
    reg sclk_prev, ss_prev;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        sclk_prev <= sclk_sync;
        ss_prev <= ss_sync;
    end
    wire sclk_rising = sclk_sync && !sclk_prev;
    wire sclk_falling = !sclk_sync && sclk_prev;
    wire ss_falling = !ss_sync && ss_prev;
    wire ss_rising = ss_sync && !ss_prev;

    // RX shift register and data capture
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] rx_shift_reg;
    reg mosi_sync0, mosi_sync;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        mosi_sync0 <= MOSI;
        mosi_sync <= mosi_sync0;
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (sclk_rising && !ss_sync)
            rx_shift_reg <= {mosi_sync, rx_shift_reg[WIDTH-1:1]};
    end

    // TX shift register and data buffering
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] tx_shift_reg;
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] next_byte;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (newTXData)
            next_byte <= byteTX;
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (ss_falling)
            tx_shift_reg <= next_byte;
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (sclk_falling && !ss_sync)
            tx_shift_reg <= {tx_shift_reg[WIDTH-2:0], 1'b0};
    end

    // MISO output (driven low when not selected)
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        MISO <= (!ss_sync) ? tx_shift_reg[WIDTH-1] : 1'b0;
    end

    // Received data output and newSPIData pulse
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] byteRX_reg;
    reg newSPIData_reg;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (ss_rising) begin
            byteRX_reg <= rx_shift_reg;
            newSPIData_reg <= 1'b1;
        end else
            newSPIData_reg <= 1'b0;
    end
    assign byteRX = byteRX_reg;
    assign newSPIData = newSPIData_reg;

    // Pending TX data tracking
    reg has_pending_tx;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (newTXData)
            has_pending_tx <= 1'b1;
        else if (ss_falling)
            has_pending_tx <= 1'b0;
    end

    // Busy signal generation
    assign busy = (!ss_sync) || has_pending_tx;

endmodule

    input rst,
    input error,
    output reg current
);

    reg [31:0] current_val;
    reg [31:0] next_current_val;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            current_val <= 0;
            current <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            current_val <= next_current_val;
            current <= (next_current_val != 0) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        end

    always @* begin
        if (error) begin
            next_current_val = current_val + k;
            if (next_current_val > 1)
                next_current_val = 1;
        end else begin
            next_current_val = current_val - k;
            if (next_current_val < 0)

        end
    end

    parameter integer C_DEFAULT_VALUE = 0,
    parameter integer C_PWM_CNT_WIDTH = 16,
    parameter integer C_FRACTIONAL_WIDTH = 16,
    parameter integer C_NUMBER_WIDTH = 32
) (
    input wire clk,
    input wire resetn,
    input wire [C_PWM_CNT_WIDTH-1:0] denominator,
    input wire [C_PWM_CNT_WIDTH-1:0] numerator0,
    input wire [C_PWM_CNT_WIDTH-1:0] numerator1,
    input wire [C_NUMBER_WIDTH-1:0] number0,
    input wire [C_NUMBER_WIDTH-1:0] number1,
    input wire [C_PWM_CNT_WIDTH+C_FRACTIONAL_WIDTH-1:0] inc0,
    output wire def_val,
    output wire exe_done,
    output wire o_resetn,
    output wire drive
);

localparam [1:0] INITIAL  = 2'b00,
                 TRANS    = 2'b01,
                 FINAL    = 2'b10;

reg [1:0] state, next_state;
reg [C_NUMBER_WIDTH-1:0] init_cnt, final_cnt;
reg exe_done_reg;
reg [C_PWM_CNT_WIDTH+C_FRACTIONAL_WIDTH-1:0] current_num;
reg [C_PWM_CNT_WIDTH-1:0] pwm_cnt;
wire period_end = (pwm_cnt == denominator - 1) && (denominator != 0);
wire [C_PWM_CNT_WIDTH-1:0] num_int = current_num >> C_FRACTIONAL_WIDTH;

assign def_val = C_DEFAULT_VALUE;
assign exe_done = exe_done_reg;
assign o_resetn = resetn;
assign drive = (pwm_cnt < num_int) ? ~C_DEFAULT_VALUE : C_DEFAULT_VALUE;

    if (!resetn) begin
        state <= INITIAL;
        init_cnt <= 0;
        final_cnt <= 0;
        exe_done_reg <= 0;
        current_num <= numerator0 << C_FRACTIONAL_WIDTH;
        pwm_cnt <= 0;
    end else begin
        exe_done_reg <= 0;

        // PWM counter
        if (denominator == 0)
            pwm_cnt <= 0;
        else if (pwm_cnt == denominator - 1)
            pwm_cnt <= 0;
        else
            pwm_cnt <= pwm_cnt + 1;

        case (state)
            INITIAL: begin
                if (number0 == 0) begin
                    state <= TRANS;
                    current_num <= numerator0 << C_FRACTIONAL_WIDTH;
                end else if (period_end) begin
                    if (init_cnt == number0 - 1) begin
                        state <= TRANS;
                        init_cnt <= 0;
                    end else
                        init_cnt <= init_cnt + 1;
                end
                current_num <= numerator0 << C_FRACTIONAL_WIDTH;
            end

            TRANS: begin
                if (period_end) begin
                    current_num <= current_num - inc0;
                    if (num_int <= numerator1) begin
                        state <= FINAL;
                        current_num <= numerator1 << C_FRACTIONAL_WIDTH;
                    end
                end
            end

            FINAL: begin
                if (number1 == 0) begin
                    exe_done_reg <= 1;
                end else if (period_end) begin
                    if (final_cnt == number1 - 1)
                        exe_done_reg <= 1;
                    else
                        final_cnt <= final_cnt + 1;
                end
                current_num <= numerator1 << C_FRACTIONAL_WIDTH;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule

);

wire [7:0] Cb = CrYCb_data[7:0];

5.  In the shifting state, the `data_out` should be updated with the *current* value of `data_in` shifted left by one.

module state_machine (
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input [31:0] data_in,
    output reg [31:0] data_out
);

localparam INITIAL = 2'd0;
localparam LOADING = 2'd1;
localparam SHIFTING = 2'd2;

reg [1:0] current_state, next_state;
reg [31:0] data_out_next;

always @(*) begin
    case (current_state)
        INITIAL: begin
            if (data_in != 32'b0) begin
                next_state = LOADING;
                data_out_next = data_in;
            end else begin
                next_state = INITIAL;
                data_out_next = 32'b0;
            end
        end
        LOADING: begin
            next_state = SHIFTING;
            data_out_next = data_in;
        end
        SHIFTING: begin
            if (data_in != 32'b0) begin
                next_state = SHIFTING;
                data_out_next = data_in << 1;
            end else begin
                next_state = INITIAL;
                data_out_next = 32'b0;
            end
        end
        default: begin
            next_state = INITIAL;
            data_out_next = 32'b0;
        end
    endcase
end

always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) begin
        current_state <= INITIAL;
        data_out <= 32'b0;
    end else begin
        current_state <= next_state;
        data_out <= data_out_next;
    end
end

endmodule

    input sdi,
    input start,
    input halfspeed,
    input [7:0] din,
    output reg sck,
    output reg sdo,
    output reg bsync,
    output reg [7:0] dout
);

// State definitions
localparam IDLE = 0;
localparam TRANSMITTING = 1;

reg state;
reg [7:0] shift_out;
reg [7:0] shift_in;
reg [1:0] counter; // Counter for SCK generation
reg [3:0] sent_counter; // Tracks transmitted bits
reg [3:0] received_counter; // Tracks received bits

always @(posedge clock) begin
    case (state)
        IDLE: begin
            bsync <= 0;
            sck <= 0;
            counter <= 0;
            sent_counter <= 0;
            received_counter <= 0;
            sdo <= 0;
            if (start) begin
                state <= TRANSMITTING;
                shift_out <= din;
                shift_in <= 8'h00;
                bsync <= 1;
            end
        end
        TRANSMITTING: begin
            // SCK generation logic
            if (counter == (halfspeed ? 2'h1 : 2'h0)) begin
                counter <= 0;
                sck <= ~sck;

                // Handle data edges
                if (sck) begin // Falling edge (was high)
                    shift_in <= {sdi, shift_in[7:1]};
                    received_counter <= received_counter + 1;
                end else begin // Rising edge (was low)
                    sdo <= shift_out[7];
                    shift_out <= {shift_out[6:0], 1'b0};
                    sent_counter <= sent_counter + 1;
                end
            end else begin
                counter <= counter + 1;
            end

            // End transaction after 8 bits
            if (sent_counter == 8 && received_counter == 8) begin
                state <= IDLE;
                dout <= shift_in;
                bsync <= 0;
                sck <= 0;
            end
        end
    endcase
end

endmodule

    input select,
    output [7:0] q,
    output done

    reg [7:0] DFF_Array [0:7];
    reg [7:0] NegEdge_OR_Result;
    reg NegEdge_Done;
    
    // Update RegA and DFF_Array on positive clock edge or reset
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        integer i;
        if (reset) begin
            // Initialize RegA and DFF_Array to 8'h34 on reset
            RegA <= 8'h34;
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                DFF_Array[i] <= 8'h34;

            RegA <= d;
            if (~select) begin

                for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                    DFF_Array[i] <= {7'b0, d[i]};

        end
    end
    
    // Update NegEdge_OR_Result and NegEdge_Done on negative clock edge or reset
    always @(negedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        integer j;
        reg all_not_34;
        if (reset) begin
            NegEdge_OR_Result <= 8'h00;
            NegEdge_Done <= 1'b0;

            all_not_34 = 1'b1;

                if (DFF_Array[j] == 8'h34) begin
                    all_not_34 = 1'b0;

    // Assign outputs based on select signal
    assign q = select ? RegA : NegEdge_OR_Result;
    assign done = NegEdge_Done;

module hi_simulate(
    input pck0, ck_1356meg, ck_1356megb,
    output pwr_lo, pwr_hi, pwr_oe1, pwr_oe2, pwr_oe3, pwr_oe4,
    input [7:0] adc_d,
    output adc_clk,
    input ssp_dout,
    output ssp_frame, ssp_din, ssp_clk,
    input cross_hi, cross_lo,
    output dbg,
    input [2:0] mod_type
);
    // Tied-low outputs
    assign pwr_hi = 1'b0;
    assign pwr_lo = 1'b0;
    assign pwr_oe3 = 1'b0;

    // ADC clock passthrough
    assign adc_clk = ck_1356meg;

    // Hysteresis logic
    reg after_hysteresis;
    always @(negedge adc_clk) begin
        if (adc_d[7:5] == 3'b111)
            after_hysteresis <= 1'b1;
        else if (adc_d[7:5] == 3'b000)
            after_hysteresis <= 1'b0;
    end

    // SSP clock generation
    reg [2:0] ssp_div_counter;
    always @(posedge adc_clk) begin
        ssp_div_counter <= ssp_div_counter + 1;
    end
    assign ssp_clk = ssp_div_counter[2]; // Using bit 2 for divide-by-8

    // Edge counters
    reg [2:0] pos_counter;
    reg [2:0] neg_counter;
    always @(posedge ssp_clk) pos_counter <= pos_counter + 1;
    always @(negedge ssp_clk) neg_counter <= neg_counter + 1;

    // SSP frame generation
    assign ssp_frame = (mod_type == 3'b000) ? (pos_counter == 3'b000) : (neg_counter == 3'b000);

    // SSP data input sampling
    reg ssp_din_reg;
    always @(posedge ssp_clk) ssp_din_reg <= after_hysteresis;
    assign ssp_din = ssp_din_reg;

    // Modulating carrier logic
    wire modulating_carrier;
    assign modulating_carrier = 
        (mod_type == 3'b001) ? (ssp_dout ^ ssp_div_counter[1]) :
        (mod_type == 3'b010) ? (ssp_dout & ssp_div_counter[0]) :
        1'b0;

    // Output assignments
    assign {pwr_oe1, pwr_oe2, pwr_oe4} = {3{modulating_carrier}};
    assign dbg = after_hysteresis;

endmodule
</verilog>

parameter D = 3'b011;

    input [17:0] tex_vmask,

module uart_core (
    input clk,
    input rxd,
    output reg [7:0] in_buffer,
    output data_rdy,
    output cts,
    input [7:0] out_buffer,
    output reg txd,
    input clear,
    input rst,
    input send
);

    // Receiver states
    localparam RX_IDLE = 2'd0;
    localparam RX_START = 2'd1;
    localparam RX_DATA = 2'd2;
    localparam RX_STOP = 2'd3;

    // Transmitter states
    localparam TX_IDLE = 2'd0;
    localparam TX_START = 2'd1;
    localparam TX_DATA = 2'd2;
    localparam TX_STOP = 2'd3;

    // Receiver signals
    reg [1:0] rx_state;
    reg [3:0] rx_counter;
    reg [2:0] rx_bit_count;
    reg [7:0] rx_shift_reg;
    reg data_rdy_pulse;

    // Transmitter signals
    reg [1:0] tx_state;
    reg [3:0] tx_counter;
    reg [3:0] tx_bit_count;
    reg [7:0] tx_shift_reg;
    reg cts_reg;

    // Data ready logic with asynchronous clear
    reg data_rdy_reg;
    assign data_rdy = data_rdy_reg;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst or posedge clear) begin
        if (rst || clear) data_rdy_reg <= 1'b0;
        else data_rdy_reg <= data_rdy_pulse;
    end

    // Receiver FSM
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            rx_state <= RX_IDLE;
            rx_counter <= 0;
            rx_bit_count <= 0;
            rx_shift_reg <= 0;
            data_rdy_pulse <= 0;
        end else begin
            data_rdy_pulse <= 0;
            case (rx_state)
                RX_IDLE: begin
                    if (!rxd) begin
                        rx_state <= RX_START;
                        rx_counter <= 0;
                    end
                end
                RX_START: begin
                    rx_counter <= rx_counter + 1;
                    if (rx_counter == 7) begin
                        if (!rxd) begin
                            rx_state <= RX_DATA;
                            rx_counter <= 0;
                            rx_bit_count <= 0;
                        end else begin
                            rx_state <= RX_IDLE;
                        end
                    end
                end
                RX_DATA: begin
                    rx_counter <= rx_counter + 1;
                    if (rx_counter == 7) begin
                        rx_shift_reg[rx_bit_count] <= rxd;
                        rx_bit_count <= rx_bit_count + 1;
                        rx_counter <= 0;
                        if (rx_bit_count == 3'd7) rx_state <= RX_STOP;
                    end
                end
                RX_STOP: begin
                    rx_counter <= rx_counter + 1;
                    if (rx_counter == 7) begin
                        if (rxd) begin
                            in_buffer <= rx_shift_reg;
                            data_rdy_pulse <= 1'b1;
                        end
                        rx_state <= RX_IDLE;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    // Transmitter FSM
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            tx_state <= TX_IDLE;
            tx_shift_reg <= 0;
            tx_counter <= 0;
            tx_bit_count <= 0;
            txd <= 1;
            cts_reg <= 1;
        end else begin
            case (tx_state)
                TX_IDLE: begin
                    cts_reg <= 1;
                    txd <= 1;
                    if (send) begin
                        tx_shift_reg <= out_buffer;
                        tx_state <= TX_START;
                        tx_counter <= 0;
                        cts_reg <= 0;
                        txd <= 0;
                    end
                end
                TX_START: begin
                    tx_counter <= tx_counter + 1;
                    if (tx_counter == 15) begin
                        tx_state <= TX_DATA;
                        tx_counter <= 0;
                        tx_bit_count <= 0;
                    end
                end
                TX_DATA: begin
                    tx_counter <= tx_counter + 1;
                    txd <= tx_shift_reg[0];
                    if (tx_counter == 15) begin
                        tx_shift_reg <= tx_shift_reg >> 1;
                        tx_bit_count <= tx_bit_count + 1;
                        tx_counter <= 0;
                        if (tx_bit_count == 7) tx_state <= TX_STOP;
                    end
                end
                TX_STOP: begin
                    tx_counter <= tx_counter + 1;
                    txd <= 1;
                    if (tx_counter == 15) begin
                        tx_state <= TX_IDLE;
                        cts_reg <= 1;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

    assign cts = cts_reg;

endmodule
</verilog>

    *   For write transactions, the CSB request can be sent immediately when the APB write transaction is valid.
    *   For read transactions, the CSB request should only be sent if a previous read request is not pending a response from the CSB interface. Implement necessary internal state to track if a read request has been sent but the corresponding `nvdla2csb_valid` has not yet been received.

    *   For write transactions, `pready` should be asserted when the CSB interface is ready to accept the write request (`csb2nvdla_ready`).
    *   For read transactions, `pready` should be asserted when the CSB interface provides valid read data (`nvdla2csb_valid`).
4.  **CSB to APB Read Data:**
    *   The APB read data output (`prdata`) should be the data received from the CSB interface (`nvdla2csb_data`).
5.  **Reset:**
    *   The module should reset asynchronously on the negative edge of `prstn`.

Design the Verilog code for the `NV_NVDLA_apb2csb` module based on these requirements.

<verilog>
module NV_NVDLA_apb2csb (
    input         pclk,
    input         prstn,
    input         psel,
    input         penable,
    input         pwrite,
    input  [31:0] paddr,
    input  [31:0] pwdata,
    output [31:0] prdata,
    output        pready,
    input         csb2nvdla_ready,
    output        csb2nvdla_valid,
    output [15:0] csb2nvdla_addr,
    output [31:0] csb2nvdla_wdat,
    output        csb2nvdla_write,
    output        csb2nvdla_nposted,
    input         nvdla2csb_valid,
    input  [31:0] nvdla2csb_data
);

    reg read_pending;

    // APB transaction detection
    wire apb_transaction = psel & penable & ~pready;

    // CSB interface assignments
    assign csb2nvdla_addr  = paddr[17:2];
    assign csb2nvdla_wdat  = pwdata;
    assign csb2nvdla_write = pwrite;
    assign csb2nvdla_nposted = 1'b0;

    // CSB valid generation
    assign csb2nvdla_valid = apb_transaction & (pwrite | (~pwrite & ~read_pending));

    // APB ready generation
    assign pready = pwrite ? (csb2nvdla_valid & csb2nvdla_ready) : 
                             ((csb2nvdla_valid & csb2nvdla_ready & nvdla2csb_valid) | 
                             (read_pending & nvdla2csb_valid));

    // APB read data assignment
    assign prdata = (pready & ~pwrite) ? nvdla2csb_data : 32'b0;

    // Read pending state management
    always @(posedge pclk or negedge prstn) begin
        if (!prstn) begin
            read_pending <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // Handle read request transmission
            if (csb2nvdla_valid && csb2nvdla_ready && ~pwrite) begin
                read_pending <= ~nvdla2csb_valid; // Clear if response in same cycle
            end
            // Handle read response reception
            else if (nvdla2csb_valid && read_pending) begin
                read_pending <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
</verilog>

    input clk,
    input reset,
    input [7:0] data_in,
    input select,
    output [9:0] data_out,
    output ready_a,
    input ready_b,
    input valid_b
);

    reg [7:0] sum_a;
    reg [2:0] counter_a;

    // Accumulator B variables
    reg [7:0] sum_b;
    reg [7:0] intermediate_b;
    reg counter_b;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            sum_a <= 8'b0;
            counter_a <= 3'b0;
        end else begin
            if (counter_a == 3'd7) begin
                sum_a <= sum_a + data_in;
                counter_a <= 3'd0;
            end else begin
                counter_a <= counter_a + 1;
            end
        end
    end

    // Accumulator B logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            sum_b <= 8'b0;
            intermediate_b <= 8'b0;
            counter_b <= 1'b0;

                intermediate_b <= 8'b0;

                intermediate_b <= intermediate_b + data_in;
            end
            counter_b <= counter_b + 1;
        end
    end

);

wire rd_allow = rd_en && !empty;

    input rx,

    parameter stateB = 5'b00010;

                if (~rx) state <= stateB;  // Detect start bit

            stateB: begin
                if (baud_rate) state <= stateC;  // Complete initial timing

            stateE: begin
                if (baud_rate) begin
                    if (rx) rx_done <= 1;  // Validate stop bit
                    state <= stateA;        // Return to idle

            end

        endcase
    end

localparam S3 = 2'b11; // 3 consecutive 1's (trigger match next cycle)

            result_exp = exp_b;

                result_sign = sign_b_eff;

            result_mantissa = 52'b0;

    input      init_done,   // DDR init complete signal

localparam INIT  = 2'd2;
localparam DONE  = 2'd3;

    parameter AW = 32,
    parameter DW = 32,
    parameter PW = 104,
    parameter ID = 12'h808
) (

    input  wire              emesh_access_in,
    input  wire [PW-1:0]     emesh_packet_in,
    input  wire [1:0]        remap_mode,
    input  wire [11:0]       remap_sel,
    input  wire [11:0]       remap_pattern,
    input  wire [31:0]       remap_base,
    output reg               emesh_access_out,
    output reg  [PW-1:0]     emesh_packet_out
);

reg [11:0] original_upper;
reg [31:0] new_addr;

    // Delay access signal by one cycle
    emesh_access_out <= emesh_access_in;

    // Extract address field from packet [39:8]
    original_addr = emesh_packet_in[39:8];
    original_upper = original_addr[31:20];

    // Determine new address based on remap rules
    if (original_upper == ID) begin
        new_addr = original_addr;

        case (remap_mode)
            2'b00: new_addr = original_addr;
            2'b01: begin
                // Static remapping: combine pattern with original upper bits
                new_addr[31:20] = (original_upper & ~remap_sel) | (remap_pattern & remap_sel);

                wire [5:0] column_id = ID[5:0];

                new_addr = original_addr + (remap_base - (column_id << 20));

    emesh_packet_out <= {emesh_packet_in[PW-1:40], new_addr, emesh_packet_in[7:0]};
end

endmodule
</verilog>

    input  wire                  s_axis_tlast,

module vga_control (
    input wire clock,
    output reg [18:0] mem_add,
    output reg vga_hsync,
    output reg vga_vsync,
    output vga_sync,
    output reg vga_blank,
    output vga_clock
);

    // Horizontal timing parameters
    parameter H_ACTIVE  = 640;
    parameter H_FRONT   = 16;
    parameter H_SYNC    = 96;
    parameter H_BACK    = 48;
    parameter H_TOTAL   = H_ACTIVE + H_FRONT + H_SYNC + H_BACK;

    // Vertical timing parameters
    parameter V_ACTIVE  = 480;
    parameter V_FRONT   = 10;
    parameter V_SYNC    = 2;
    parameter V_BACK    = 33;
    parameter V_TOTAL   = V_ACTIVE + V_FRONT + V_SYNC + V_BACK;

    reg [9:0] h_counter = 0;
    reg [9:0] v_counter = 0;

    // Generate horizontal and vertical counters
    always @(posedge clock) begin
        if (h_counter == H_TOTAL - 1) begin
            h_counter <= 0;
            if (v_counter == V_TOTAL - 1)
                v_counter <= 0;
            else
                v_counter <= v_counter + 1;
        end else begin
            h_counter <= h_counter + 1;
        end
    end

    // Generate sync signals and memory address
    always @(*) begin
        // Horizontal sync (active low)
        vga_hsync = (h_counter >= (H_ACTIVE + H_FRONT)) && (h_counter < (H_ACTIVE + H_FRONT + H_SYNC)) ? 1'b0 : 1'b1;

        // Vertical sync (active high)
        vga_vsync = (v_counter >= (V_ACTIVE + V_FRONT)) && (v_counter < (V_ACTIVE + V_FRONT + V_SYNC)) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;

        // Blanking signal (active high during active area)
        vga_blank = (h_counter < H_ACTIVE) && (v_counter < V_ACTIVE);

        // Memory address calculation
        mem_add = (v_counter < V_ACTIVE) && (h_counter < H_ACTIVE) ? 
                 (v_counter * H_ACTIVE + h_counter) : 19'd0;
    end

    // Constant sync signal and inverted clock
    assign vga_sync = 1'b0;
    assign vga_clock = ~clock;

endmodule
</verilog>

- The red light should remain lit for a total of 11 clock cycles.

module traffic_light (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    output reg green,
    output reg yellow,
    output reg red
);

// State definitions
localparam GREEN_STATE  = 2'b00;
localparam YELLOW_STATE = 2'b01;
localparam RED_STATE    = 2'b10;

// State and counter registers
reg [1:0] current_state, next_state;
reg [3:0] count, next_count;

// State transition and counter update logic
always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        current_state <= GREEN_STATE;
        count <= 4'd10; // 11 cycles: count from 10 down to 0 (inclusive)
        green <= 1;
        yellow <= 0;
        red <= 0;
    end else begin
        current_state <= next_state;
        count <= next_count;
        // Update outputs based on next_state
        case (next_state)
            GREEN_STATE: begin
                green <= 1;
                yellow <= 0;
                red <= 0;
            end
            YELLOW_STATE: begin
                green <= 0;
                yellow <= 1;
                red <= 0;
            end
            RED_STATE: begin
                green <= 0;
                yellow <= 0;
                red <= 1;
            end
            default: begin
                green <= 1;
                yellow <= 0;
                red <= 0;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

// Combinational logic to determine next state and next count
always @* begin
    // Default assignments
    next_state = current_state;
    next_count = count;
    
    if (count == 0) begin
        // Transition to next state
        case (current_state)
            GREEN_STATE: begin
                next_state = YELLOW_STATE;
                next_count = 4'd2; // 3 cycles: count from 2 down to 0
            end
            YELLOW_STATE: begin
                next_state = RED_STATE;
                next_count = 4'd10; // 11 cycles
            end
            RED_STATE: begin
                next_state = GREEN_STATE;
                next_count = 4'd10;
            end
            default: begin
                next_state = GREEN_STATE;
                next_count = 4'd10;
            end
        endcase
    end else begin
        // Decrement counter
        next_count = count - 1;
    end
end

endmodule
</verilog>

    input clk7_en,
    input dmal,
    input dmas,

    input [8:1] reg_address_in,
    input [15:0] data_in,

    parameter DSKPTL = 9'h022;

   input         reset,
   input [3:0]   rri_valid,
   output [3:0]  rri_ready,
   input [63:0]  rri_addr_0,
   input [63:0]  rri_addr_1,

   input         rro_ready,
   output [63:0] rro_addr,
   output [7:0]  rro_tag
);

         current_counter <= current_counter + 1;

The module should define the following parameters:

- `DDS_BITS_PP` with a value of 6.

The implementation should follow these principles:

2.  A DDS phase accumulator, with a width of `DDS_BITS_PP`, should be clocked by the output of the prescaler (the divided clock).
3.  The phase increment for the DDS accumulator should be the `frequency` input value.
4.  The output clock `clk_out` should be generated by detecting the rising edge of the most significant bit of the DDS phase accumulator.
5.  The `reset` signal should initialize the necessary internal state elements.

module clock_gen #(
    parameter DDS_PRESCALE_NDIV_PP = 5,
    parameter DDS_PRESCALE_BITS_PP = 3,
    parameter DDS_BITS_PP = 6
) (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    input [DDS_BITS_PP-2:0] frequency,
    output clk_out
);

    reg [DDS_PRESCALE_BITS_PP-1:0] prescaler_counter;
    reg divided_clk;
    reg [DDS_BITS_PP-1:0] phase_accumulator;

    // Prescaler logic (divide by DDS_PRESCALE_NDIV_PP)
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            prescaler_counter <= 0;
            divided_clk <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (prescaler_counter == DDS_PRESCALE_NDIV_PP - 1) begin
                prescaler_counter <= 0;
                divided_clk <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                prescaler_counter <= prescaler_counter + 1;
                divided_clk <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // DDS phase accumulator
    always @(posedge divided_clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            phase_accumulator <= 0;
        end else begin
            phase_accumulator <= phase_accumulator + {1'b0, frequency};
        end
    end

    // Output clock generation
    assign clk_out = phase_accumulator[DDS_BITS_PP-1];

endmodule
</verilog>

module TDC #(
    parameter n = 8,
    parameter resolution = 1
)(
    input start,
    input stop,
    input clk,
    output reg [n-1:0] out
);

    reg [n-1:0] free_counter = 0;
    reg [n-1:0] start_time = 0;
    reg counting = 0;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        free_counter <= free_counter + 1;

        if (~counting && start) begin

            counting <= 1;

    input S0, S1,
    output Y
);

module snes_controller_adapter (
    input clock,
    input reset,
    input [1:0] button_sel,
    input controller_data,
    output reg [3:0] button_data,
    output reg controller_latch,
    output reg controller_clock
);

// State machine states
localparam IDLE    = 2'd0;
localparam LATCH   = 2'd1;
localparam READING = 2'd2;

// Controller signals
reg [1:0] state;
reg [4:0] bit_counter;  // 0-16 counter for read cycle
reg [15:0] button_reg;  // Stored button states (active low)
reg clock_phase;         // Internal clock phase tracking

// State transitions and control logic
always @(posedge clock or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
        state <= IDLE;
        button_reg <= 16'hFFFF;
        bit_counter <= 0;
        controller_latch <= 0;
        controller_clock <= 1;
        clock_phase <= 1;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                // Start new read cycle periodically
                controller_latch <= 1;
                state <= LATCH;
                controller_clock <= 1;
                clock_phase <= 1;
            end

            LATCH: begin
                // End latch pulse and prepare reading
                controller_latch <= 0;
                state <= READING;
                bit_counter <= 0;
            end

            READING: begin
                // Generate controller_clock and capture data
                if (bit_counter < 16) begin
                    // Toggle clock every other cycle
                    clock_phase <= ~clock_phase;
                    controller_clock <= clock_phase;

                    // Capture data on falling edge (common SNES timing)
                    if (clock_phase == 0) begin
                        button_reg <= {button_reg[14:0], controller_data};
                        bit_counter <= bit_counter + 1;
                    end
                end else begin
                    // Return to idle after 16 bits
                    state <= IDLE;
                    controller_clock <= 1;
                end
            end
        endcase
    end
end

// Button output multiplexer

    case (button_sel)
        2'b00, 2'b01: button_data = {button_reg[7], button_reg[6], button_reg[4], button_reg[5]};
        2'b10:        button_data = {button_reg[8], button_reg[0], button_reg[2], button_reg[3]};
        default:      button_data = 4'b1111; // sel=11
    endcase
end

endmodule
</verilog>

Write a Verilog module named `sigma_delta` that processes a high-speed 1-bit digital bitstream, typically the output of a sigma-delta modulator, and produces a lower-speed 1-bit digital output representing the sign of a filtered value.

The module should have the following interface:

*   Input `clk`: The clock signal for synchronous operations.
*   Output `digital_signal`: The lower-speed 1-bit output.

The module should use the following parameters:
*   `OVERSAMPLE`: An integer parameter determining the size of an initial input buffer/oversampling stage.
*   `DELAY`: An integer parameter defining the length of a delay element used within the digital filter.
*   `COEFFS`: A multi-bit parameter representing a constant coefficient used in the digital filtering process.

The implementation should include the following functional blocks, operating synchronously with the `clk`:
1.  An input buffering stage that captures a history of the `analog_signal` based on the `OVERSAMPLE` parameter.
2.  A conceptual quantization stage that selects the most recent bit from the input buffering stage.
3.  A digital filter stage that processes the (quantized) bitstream. This filter should utilize a delay line of length `DELAY`. The core filtering operation involves accumulating a value based on the oldest bit currently in the delay line and the constant `COEFFS` parameter.
4.  An output stage that generates the `digital_signal` by taking the most significant bit (sign bit) of the accumulated value from the digital filter.

Do not include testbenches or synthesis constraints. Provide only the module definition.

module sigma_delta #(
    parameter OVERSAMPLE = 1,
    parameter DELAY = 1,
    parameter COEFFS = 1
) (
    input analog_signal,
    input clk,
    output reg digital_signal
);

    reg [OVERSAMPLE-1:0] input_buffer;
    wire quantized_bit = input_buffer[OVERSAMPLE-1];
    reg [DELAY-1:0] delay_line;
    reg signed [31:0] accumulator = 0;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        // Input buffering stage (shifts new bit into MSB position)
        input_buffer <= {analog_signal, input_buffer[OVERSAMPLE-1:1]};

        // Digital filter stage
        if (DELAY > 0) begin
            // Capture oldest bit from delay line before shifting
            reg oldest_bit = delay_line[DELAY-1];
            accumulator <= accumulator + (oldest_bit * $signed(COEFFS));
            delay_line <= {delay_line[DELAY-2:0], quantized_bit};
        end else begin
            accumulator <= accumulator + (quantized_bit * $signed(COEFFS));
        end

        // Output stage (MSB as sign bit)
        digital_signal <= accumulator[$bits(accumulator)-1];
    end

endmodule

    input HRESETN,
    input HSEL,
    input HWRITE,
    input [31:0] HADDR,
    input [31:0] HWDATA,
    input HREADYIN,
    input [1:0] HTRANS,
    input [2:0] HSIZE,
    input [2:0] HBURST,
    input HMASTLOCK,
    input [3:0] HPROT,
    input [31:0] PRDATA,
    input PREADY,
    input PSLVERR,
    output reg [31:0] HRDATA,
    output reg HREADYOUT,
    output reg HRESP,
    output reg [15:0] PSEL,
    output reg [31:0] PADDR,
    output reg PWRITE,
    output reg PENABLE,
    output reg [31:0] PWDATA
);

localparam IDLE = 1'b0;
localparam APB_ACCESS = 1'b1;

reg current_state;
reg [31:0] captured_HADDR;
reg captured_HWRITE;
reg [31:0] captured_HWDATA;

always @(posedge HCLK or negedge HRESETN) begin
    if (!HRESETN) begin
        current_state <= IDLE;
        captured_HADDR <= 32'h0;
        captured_HWRITE <= 1'b0;
        captured_HWDATA <= 32'h0;
        HRESP <= 1'b0;

            IDLE: begin

                    current_state <= APB_ACCESS;
                    captured_HADDR <= HADDR;
                    captured_HWRITE <= HWRITE;
                    captured_HWDATA <= HWDATA;

                HRESP <= 1'b0;
            end
            APB_ACCESS: begin
                if (PREADY) begin
                    current_state <= IDLE;
                    HRESP <= PSLVERR;
                end
            end
        endcase
    end
end

always @(*) begin
    PSEL = (current_state == IDLE) ? 16'h0000 : (16'h0001 << captured_HADDR[27:24]);
    PADDR = (current_state == IDLE) ? 32'h0 : captured_HADDR;
    PWRITE = (current_state == IDLE) ? 1'b0 : captured_HWRITE;
    PENABLE = (current_state == APB_ACCESS);
    PWDATA = (current_state == IDLE || !captured_HWRITE) ? 32'h0 : captured_HWDATA;
    HREADYOUT = (current_state == IDLE) ? 1'b1 : (PREADY && !PSLVERR);
    HRDATA = PRDATA;
end

endmodule
</verilog>

-   Input `[7:0] V_ctrl`: An 8-bit digital control signal.
-   Output `reg vco`: The generated output signal.

The module should use the following parameters:

-   `f_max`: A frequency parameter.

The module's behavior is as follows:

module VCO_interface (
    input clk,
    input [7:0] V_ctrl,
    output reg vco
);

    parameter f_clk;          // Reference clock frequency in Hz
    parameter V_min;          // Minimum value of V_ctrl
    parameter V_max;          // Maximum value of V_ctrl
    parameter f_min;          // Minimum output frequency in Hz
    parameter f_max;          // Maximum output frequency in Hz

    // Calculate divider range based on frequency parameters
    localparam divider_max = (f_clk / (2 * f_min)) - 1;
    localparam divider_min = (f_clk / (2 * f_max)) - 1;
    localparam divider_width = $clog2(divider_max + 1);

    reg [divider_width-1:0] counter;
    reg [divider_width-1:0] divider;

    // Combinatorial divider calculation
    always @(*) begin
        if (V_ctrl <= V_min) begin
            divider = divider_max;
        end else if (V_ctrl >= V_max) begin
            divider = divider_min;
        end else begin
            divider = divider_max - ((V_ctrl - V_min) * (divider_max - divider_min)) / (V_max - V_min);
        end
    end

    // Counter and VCO generation logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (counter == divider) begin
            vco <= ~vco;
            counter <= 0;
        end else begin
            counter <= counter + 1;
        end
    end

endmodule
</verilog>

module aq_div31x31 (
    input wire RST_N,
    input wire CLK,
    input wire [30:0] DINA,
    input wire [30:0] DINB,
    output reg [30:0] QOUT,
    output reg [30:0] ROUT
);

    reg [30:0] divr [0:30];
    reg [30:0] divd [0:30];
    reg [31:0] rem [0:30];
    reg [30:0] quo [0:30];

    integer i;

    always @(posedge CLK or negedge RST_N) begin
        if (!RST_N) begin
            for (i = 0; i < 31; i = i + 1) begin
                divr[i] <= 31'b0;
                divd[i] <= 31'b0;
                rem[i] <= 32'b0;
                quo[i] <= 31'b0;
            end
            QOUT <= 31'b0;
            ROUT <= 31'b0;
        end else begin
            // Stage 0: Initialize with inputs
            divr[0] <= DINB;
            divd[0] <= DINA;
            rem[0] <= 32'b0;
            quo[0] <= 31'b0;

            // Process stages 1 through 30
            for (i = 1; i < 31; i = i + 1) begin
                reg [31:0] new_rem;
                reg [30:0] new_quo;
                reg current_bit;

                // Extract current bit from previous dividend
                current_bit = divd[i-1][30];
                new_rem = (rem[i-1] << 1) | current_bit;

                if (new_rem >= {1'b0, divr[i-1]}) begin
                    new_rem = new_rem - {1'b0, divr[i-1]};
                    new_quo = quo[i-1];
                    new_quo[30 - (i-1)] = 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    new_quo = quo[i-1];
                    new_quo[30 - (i-1)] = 1'b0;
                end

                // Update pipeline registers
                divr[i] <= divr[i-1];
                divd[i] <= divd[i-1] << 1;
                rem[i] <= new_rem;
                quo[i] <= new_quo;
            end

            // Output from final stage
            QOUT <= quo[30];
            ROUT <= rem[30][30:0];
        end
    end

endmodule
</verilog>

    *   `alex_data[2]` is high when bit 0 of the captured 2-bit data is high, AND bit 6 AND bit 11 of the internal counter are both high.
    *   `alex_data[3]` is high when bit 1 of the captured 2-bit data is high, AND bit 6 AND bit 11 of the internal counter are both high.

    input wire aclk,
    input wire aresetn,
    input wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
    input wire s_axis_tvalid,
    output wire s_axis_tready,
    output wire [3:0] alex_data
);

reg processing_active;
reg [15:0] data_reg;
reg [1:0] bits_reg;
reg [15:0] counter;
reg pulse_ready;
reg prev_processing_active;

always @(posedge aclk or negedge aresetn) begin
    if (!aresetn) begin
        processing_active <= 1'b0;
        data_reg <= 16'b0;
        bits_reg <= 2'b0;
        counter <= 16'b0;
        pulse_ready <= 1'b1;
        prev_processing_active <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        prev_processing_active <= processing_active;

        // Default assignments
        pulse_ready <= 1'b0;

        if (processing_active) begin
            counter <= counter + 1;

            // Check for termination condition (bit 7 and 11 high)
            if (counter[7] && counter[11]) begin
                processing_active <= 1'b0;
            end

            // Data shift when lower 7 bits are all 1's
            if (counter[6:0] == 7'b111_1111) begin
                data_reg <= {data_reg[14:0], 1'b0};
            end
        end else begin
            // Generate pulse_ready on falling edge of processing_active
            if (prev_processing_active && !processing_active) begin
                pulse_ready <= 1'b1;
            end

            // Capture new data when ready
            if (pulse_ready && s_axis_tvalid) begin
                data_reg <= s_axis_tdata[15:0];
                bits_reg <= s_axis_tdata[17:16];
                processing_active <= 1'b1;
                counter <= 16'b0;
                pulse_ready <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end
end

assign s_axis_tready = pulse_ready;

// Output generation
assign alex_data[0] = data_reg[15];
assign alex_data[1] = (counter[6] && !counter[11]);
assign alex_data[2] = (bits_reg[0] && counter[6] && counter[11]);
assign alex_data[3] = (bits_reg[1] && counter[6] && counter[11]);

endmodule

    output reg done,

localparam STOP  = 2'b11;

- If `right` is asserted (and conditions are met): 8'b0000_0010

    output reg miso,
    output reg done,
    output wire [bc-1:0] dout

module communication_module (

    input rst,
    input ready_op,
    input max_tick_address,
    input max_tick_ch,
    input TX_DONE,
    output reg beg_op,
    output reg ack_op,
    output reg load_address,
    output reg enab_address,
    output reg enab_ch,
    output reg load_ch,
    output reg TX_START
);

// Define symbolic states
localparam [3:0] 
    INIT          = 4'd0,
    LOAD_ADDR     = 4'd1,
    BEGIN_OP      = 4'd2,
    INIT_CH       = 4'd3,
    WAIT_READY    = 4'd4,
    START_TX      = 4'd5,
    WAIT_TX_DONE  = 4'd6,
    CHECK_CHANNEL = 4'd7,
    ENABLE_CH     = 4'd8,
    CHECK_ADDRESS = 4'd9,
    ENABLE_ADDR   = 4'd10,
    IDLE          = 4'd11;

reg [3:0] state, next_state;

// Synchronous state register update
always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if (rst) state <= INIT;
    else     state <= next_state;
end

// Combinational next state and output logic
always @(*) begin
    // Default values
    next_state = state;
    beg_op = 1'b0;
    ack_op = 1'b0;
    load_address = 1'b0;
    enab_address = 1'b0;
    enab_ch = 1'b0;
    load_ch = 1'b0;
    TX_START = 1'b0;

    case (state)
        INIT: begin
            next_state = LOAD_ADDR;
        end

        LOAD_ADDR: begin
            load_address = 1'b1;
            enab_address = 1'b1;
            next_state = BEGIN_OP;
        end

        BEGIN_OP: begin
            beg_op = 1'b1;
            next_state = INIT_CH;
        end

        INIT_CH: begin
            load_ch = 1'b1;
            enab_ch = 1'b1;
            next_state = WAIT_READY;
        end

        WAIT_READY: begin
            if (ready_op) begin
                next_state = START_TX;
            end
        end

        START_TX: begin
            TX_START = 1'b1;
            next_state = WAIT_TX_DONE;
        end

        WAIT_TX_DONE: begin
            if (TX_DONE) begin
                next_state = CHECK_CHANNEL;
            end
        end

        CHECK_CHANNEL: begin
            if (!max_tick_ch) begin
                next_state = ENABLE_CH;
            end else begin
                next_state = CHECK_ADDRESS;
            end
        end

        ENABLE_CH: begin
            enab_ch = 1'b1;
            next_state = WAIT_READY;
        end

        CHECK_ADDRESS: begin
            if (!max_tick_address) begin
                next_state = ENABLE_ADDR;
            end else begin
                next_state = IDLE;
            end
        end

        ENABLE_ADDR: begin
            enab_address = 1'b1;
            ack_op = 1'b1;
            next_state = BEGIN_OP;
        end

        IDLE: begin
            // Stay in IDLE until reset
            next_state = IDLE;
        end

        default: next_state = INIT;
    endcase
end

endmodule
</verilog>

    input rst,
    input [31:0] pc,
    input update_btb_tag,
    input update_btb_target,
    input [31:0] btb_target_in,
    input [1:0] btb_type_in,
    input PHT_pred_taken,
    output reg btb_v,
    output reg [31:0] btb_target_out,
    output reg [1:0] btb_type_out,
    output reg en_btb_pred
);

    parameter pc_tag_width = 11;
    parameter btb_target_width = 32;
    parameter btb_depth = 64;
    parameter BTB_TARGET_INIT = 32'h00000000;
    parameter BTB_TAG_INIT = 11'b00000000000;

    reg [10:0] btb_tag [0:btb_depth-1];
    reg [31:0] btb_target [0:btb_depth-1];

    wire [5:0] pc_index = pc[5:0];
    wire [10:0] calculated_tag;
    reg [10:0] stored_tag;
    reg [31:0] stored_target_entry;

    wire btb_v_comb;
    wire [31:0] btb_target_comb;
    wire [1:0] btb_type_comb;
    wire en_btb_pred_comb;

    assign calculated_tag = pc[31:21] ^ pc[20:10] ^ {pc[9:6], 7'b0};

    always @(*) begin
        stored_tag = btb_tag[pc_index];
        stored_target_entry = btb_target[pc_index];
        btb_v_comb = (stored_tag == calculated_tag);
        btb_type_comb = stored_target_entry[1:0];
        btb_target_comb = {stored_target_entry[31:2], 2'b00};
        en_btb_pred_comb = btb_v_comb & PHT_pred_taken;
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            integer i;
            for (i = 0; i < btb_depth; i = i + 1) begin
                btb_tag[i] <= BTB_TAG_INIT;
                btb_target[i] <= BTB_TARGET_INIT;
            end
            btb_v <= 0;
            btb_target_out <= 0;
            btb_type_out <= 0;
            en_btb_pred <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (update_btb_tag)
                btb_tag[pc_index] <= calculated_tag;
            if (update_btb_target)
                btb_target[pc_index] <= {btb_target_in[31:2], btb_type_in};

            btb_v <= btb_v_comb;
            btb_target_out <= btb_target_comb;
            btb_type_out <= btb_type_comb;
            en_btb_pred <= en_btb_pred_comb;
        end
    end

endmodule
</verilog>

Design a Verilog module named `oversampling` with the following interface:
`input [7:0]sclk`, `input sdata`, `output [7:0]samples`, `output reg [7:0]trans`.

The module should process the single bit input `sdata` by sampling it using the individual bits of the 8-bit clock `sclk` as distinct clock signals. These initial samples are then processed through subsequent stages of registration.

The `samples` output should provide the value of the sampled data after it has been registered twice on the positive edge of `sclk[0]`.

The `trans` output should be registered on the positive edge of `sclk[0]`. Before being registered, its value is derived from a version of the sampled data that has been registered once on the positive edge of `sclk[0]`. Specifically, bit `i` of the value (for i=0 to 6) is the XOR of bit `i` and bit `i+1` of the singly registered data. Bit 7 of the value is the XOR of bit 7 of the singly registered data and bit 0 of the data *before* it was registered on `sclk[0]`.

Implement the necessary logic to achieve this behavior.

module oversampling (
    input [7:0] sclk,
    input sdata,
    output [7:0] samples,
    output reg [7:0] trans
);

reg [7:0] stage2, stage3;

// Generate individual flip-flops for each sclk bit
generate
    genvar i;
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : gen_stage1
        always @(posedge sclk[i]) begin
            stage1[i] <= sdata;
        end
    end
endgenerate

// Two-stage registration using sclk[0]
always @(posedge sclk[0]) begin
    stage2 <= stage1;
    stage3 <= stage2;
end

assign samples = stage3;

// Combinational logic for trans
wire [7:0] trans_comb;
assign trans_comb[0] = stage2[0] ^ stage2[1];
assign trans_comb[1] = stage2[1] ^ stage2[2];
assign trans_comb[2] = stage2[2] ^ stage2[3];
assign trans_comb[3] = stage2[3] ^ stage2[4];
assign trans_comb[4] = stage2[4] ^ stage2[5];
assign trans_comb[5] = stage2[5] ^ stage2[6];
assign trans_comb[6] = stage2[6] ^ stage2[7];
assign trans_comb[7] = stage2[7] ^ stage1[0];

// Register trans value
always @(posedge sclk[0]) begin
    trans <= trans_comb;
end

endmodule

<verilog>
module controller (
    input clock,
    input reset,
    input run,
    input wrSize,
    input [31:0] config_data,
    input validIn,
    input [31:0] dataIn,
    input busy,
    input arm,
    output send,
    output [31:0] memoryWrData,
    output memoryRead,
    output memoryWrite,
    output memoryLastWrite
);

localparam IDLE     = 3'd0;
localparam SAMPLE   = 3'd1;
localparam DELAY    = 3'd2;
localparam READ     = 3'd3;
localparam READ_WAIT= 3'd4;

reg [2:0] current_state, next_state;
reg [15:0] reg_config_upper, reg_config_lower;
reg [15:0] counter;
reg [31:0] memoryWrData_reg;

// Configuration registers update
always @(posedge clock or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
        reg_config_upper <= 16'b0;
        reg_config_lower <= 16'b0;
    end else if (wrSize) begin
        reg_config_upper <= config_data[31:16];
        reg_config_lower <= config_data[15:0];
    end
end

// State machine transition
always @(posedge clock or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) current_state <= IDLE;
    else current_state <= next_state;
end

// Next state logic
always @(*) begin
    next_state = current_state;
    case (current_state)
        IDLE: begin
            if (run) next_state = DELAY;
            else if (arm) next_state = SAMPLE;
        end
        SAMPLE: if (run) next_state = DELAY;
        DELAY: if (validIn && (counter == reg_config_upper)) next_state = READ;
        READ: next_state = (counter == reg_config_lower) ? IDLE : READ_WAIT;
        READ_WAIT: if (!busy && !send) next_state = READ;
        default: next_state = IDLE;
    endcase
end

// Counter logic
always @(posedge clock or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) counter <= 16'b0;
    else begin
        case (current_state)
            IDLE, SAMPLE: counter <= 16'b0;
            DELAY: if (validIn) counter <= (counter == reg_config_upper) ? 16'b0 : counter + 1;
            READ: counter <= (counter == reg_config_lower) ? 16'b0 : counter + 1;
            default: counter <= counter;
        endcase
    end
end

// memoryWrData delay register
always @(posedge clock or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) memoryWrData_reg <= 32'b0;
    else memoryWrData_reg <= dataIn;
end

// Output assignments with reset override
assign memoryWrite = (reset) ? 1'b0 :
                    (current_state == IDLE) ? 1'b1 :
                    ((current_state == SAMPLE || current_state == DELAY) && validIn);

assign memoryLastWrite = (reset) ? 1'b0 :
                        (current_state == DELAY && counter == reg_config_upper);

assign memoryRead = (reset) ? 1'b0 : (current_state == READ);
assign send = (current_state == READ);
assign memoryWrData = memoryWrData_reg;

endmodule
</verilog>

2. When the effective input transitions to or is high while the module is in a specific 'ready' state, the module should generate a single clock cycle high pulse on `io_out`.
3. After generating this pulse, the module should enter a one-clock-cycle 'lockout' state during which it cannot immediately generate another pulse.
4. During this one-clock-cycle 'lockout' state, the output `io_out` should follow the value of the effective input.
5. After the 'lockout' state, the module should return to the 'ready' state.
6. A synchronous reset should set the module to the 'ready' state with `io_out` low.

module Depulser (
    input clock,
    input reset,
    input io_in,
    input io_rst,
    output reg io_out
);

    // Define states
    reg state;
    localparam READY = 1'b0;
    localparam LOCKOUT = 1'b1;

    // Effective input calculation
    wire effective_in = io_rst ? 1'b0 : io_in;

    always @(posedge clock) begin
        if (reset) begin
            // Synchronous reset to READY state with output low
            state <= READY;
            io_out <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)

                    if (effective_in) begin
                        // Generate pulse and enter lockout
                        io_out <= 1'b1;
                        state <= LOCKOUT;
                    end else begin
                        // Stay in ready with output low
                        io_out <= 1'b0;
                        state <= READY;
                    end
                end
                LOCKOUT: begin
                    // Follow effective input and return to ready
                    io_out <= effective_in;
                    state <= READY;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

    output wire [9:0] pixel_y  // Current vertical coordinate

    parameter H_FRONT_PORCH = 16;   // Horizontal front porch
    parameter H_SYNC       = 96;    // Horizontal sync pulse
    parameter H_BACK_PORCH  = 48;   // Horizontal back porch
    
    // Vertical timing parameters (default: 640x480 @60Hz)
    parameter V_DISPLAY    = 480;   // Vertical display area
    parameter V_FRONT_PORCH = 10;   // Vertical front porch
    parameter V_SYNC       = 2;     // Vertical sync pulse
    parameter V_BACK_PORCH  = 33;   // Vertical back porch

    localparam H_TOTAL = H_DISPLAY + H_FRONT_PORCH + H_SYNC + H_BACK_PORCH;
    localparam V_TOTAL = V_DISPLAY + V_FRONT_PORCH + V_SYNC + V_BACK_PORCH;

    localparam H_SYNC_END   = H_SYNC_START + H_SYNC;
    
    localparam V_SYNC_START = V_DISPLAY + V_FRONT_PORCH;
    localparam V_SYNC_END   = V_SYNC_START + V_SYNC;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst)
        if (rst) pclk_reg <= 1'b0;
        else     pclk_reg <= ~pclk_reg;

    reg [9:0] v_count;

        if (rst)
            h_count <= 10'd0;
        else if (p_tick) begin
            if (h_count == H_TOTAL - 1)
                h_count <= 10'd0;
            else
                h_count <= h_count + 10'd1;
        end
    end

    // Vertical counter
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst)
            v_count <= 10'd0;
        else if (p_tick) begin
            if (h_count == H_TOTAL - 1) begin
                if (v_count == V_TOTAL - 1)
                    v_count <= 10'd0;
                else

    assign video_on = (h_count < H_DISPLAY) && (v_count < V_DISPLAY);

    assign pixel_x = h_count;
    assign pixel_y = v_count;

    parameter integer M = 1,
    parameter integer C = 1
) (

    input ref_clk,
    output clk_out,
    output data_out
);

    data_in_sync1 <= data_in;

    if (data_edge)

    if (data_edge)

end

    input [31:0] rs,
    input [31:0] rt,
    output reg [31:0] outALU,
    output reg outBranch
);

    localparam ADD  = 6'd1;
    localparam ADDI = 6'd2;
    localparam SUB  = 6'd3;
    localparam SUBI = 6'd4;
    localparam MUL  = 6'd5;
    localparam DIV  = 6'd6;
    localparam MOD  = 6'd7;
    localparam AND  = 6'd8;
    localparam ANDI = 6'd9;
    localparam OR   = 6'd10;

            BNE: begin

    parameter DataWidth = 8
) (
    input Reset_n_i,
    input Clk_i,
    input Enable_i,
    input MeasureFSM_Done_i,
    input [DataWidth-1:0] MeasureFSM_Byte0_i,
    input [DataWidth-1:0] MeasureFSM_Byte1_i,
    input [2*DataWidth-1:0] ParamThreshold_i,
    input [4*DataWidth-1:0] ParamCounterPreset_i,
    output reg CpuIntr_o,
    output [2*DataWidth-1:0] SensorValue_o,
    output reg MeasureFSM_Start_o
);

localparam [2:0]
    S_DISABLED = 3'd0,
    S_IDLE     = 3'd1,
    S_WAITING  = 3'd2,
    S_NOTIFY   = 3'd3;

reg [2:0] current_state, next_state;
reg [4*DataWidth-1:0] timer;
reg [2*DataWidth-1:0] Word0;
reg update_word0;

wire [2*DataWidth-1:0] new_value;
wire [2*DataWidth-1:0] difference;

assign difference = (new_value >= Word0) ? (new_value - Word0) : (Word0 - new_value);
assign SensorValue_o = Word0;
