    if (!Reset_n_i) begin
        current_state <= S_DISABLED;
    end else begin
        current_state <= next_state;
    end

    if (!Reset_n_i) begin
        timer <= 0;
    end else begin
        if ((current_state != S_IDLE) && (next_state == S_IDLE)) begin
            timer <= ParamCounterPreset_i;
        end else if (current_state == S_IDLE && Enable_i && timer > 0) begin
            timer <= timer - 1;
        end
    end

// Word0 update
always @(posedge Clk_i or negedge Reset_n_i) begin
    if (!Reset_n_i) begin
        Word0 <= 0;
    end else if (update_word0) begin
        Word0 <= new_value;
    end
end

// Next state and output logic
always @(*) begin
    next_state = current_state;
    MeasureFSM_Start_o = 1'b0;
    CpuIntr_o = 1'b0;
    update_word0 = 1'b0;

    case (current_state)
        S_DISABLED: begin
            if (Enable_i) begin
                next_state = S_IDLE;
            end
        end

        S_IDLE: begin
            if (!Enable_i) begin
                next_state = S_DISABLED;
            end else if (timer == 0) begin
                MeasureFSM_Start_o = 1'b1;
                next_state = S_WAITING;
            end
        end

        S_WAITING: begin
            if (MeasureFSM_Done_i) begin
                if (difference > ParamThreshold_i) begin
                    next_state = S_NOTIFY;
                    update_word0 = 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    next_state = S_IDLE;
                end
            end
        end

        S_NOTIFY: begin
            CpuIntr_o = 1'b1;
            next_state = S_IDLE;
        end

        default: next_state = S_DISABLED;
    endcase
end

endmodule
</verilog>

The machine should have the following basic behavior:

2.  When in the initial state, asserting `coin_insert` should move it to a state where product selection is possible and increment an internal coin count.
3.  In the product selection state, asserting `product_select` should increment an internal product selection counter. If the accumulated coin count is greater than or equal to the selected product count, the machine should transition to a dispensing state.
4.  In the dispensing state, the machine should assert the `dispense` output, decrement the internal coin count by the product cost (represented by the product selection counter), and set the `display` output to show the selected product value.
5.  After dispensing, the machine should transition back to the initial state, potentially after a brief period to de-assert the `dispense` signal.
6.  If insufficient coins are inserted when a product is selected, the machine should remain in the selection state.

The module should manage the internal state, track the cumulative coins inserted, and keep track of the selected product. Assume `coin_insert` and `product_select` are pulsed for one clock cycle.

module vending_machine (
    input clk,
    input reset,
    input coin_insert,
    input product_select,
    output dispense,
    output [3:0] display
);
    // State definitions
    localparam IDLE      = 2'b00;
    localparam SELECT    = 2'b01;
    localparam DISPENSE  = 2'b10;
    
    reg [1:0] current_state, next_state;
    reg [3:0] coins_reg;
    reg [3:0] product_sel_reg;
    
    // Output assignments
    assign dispense = (current_state == DISPENSE);
    assign display  = (current_state == DISPENSE) ? product_sel_reg : 4'b0;
    
    // State transitions and registers
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            current_state   <= IDLE;
            coins_reg       <= 4'b0;
            product_sel_reg <= 4'b0;
        end else begin
            case (current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (coin_insert) begin
                        coins_reg       <= coins_reg + 1;
                        current_state   <= SELECT;
                    end
                end
                
                SELECT: begin
                    if (coin_insert) begin
                        coins_reg <= coins_reg + 1;
                    end
                    
                    if (product_select) begin
                        // Update product selection
                        product_sel_reg <= product_sel_reg + 1;
                        
                        // Check if coins (current + any increment from coin_insert) >= product_sel +1
                        if ( (coins_reg + (coin_insert ? 4'b1 : 4'b0)) >= (product_sel_reg + 1) ) begin
                            current_state <= DISPENSE;
                        end else begin
                            current_state <= SELECT;
                        end
                    end
                end
                
                DISPENSE: begin
                    // Deduct product cost and reset product selection
                    coins_reg       <= coins_reg - product_sel_reg;
                    product_sel_reg <= 4'b0;
                    current_state   <= IDLE;
                end
                
                default: current_state <= IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
</verilog>

module udp_reg_path_decode (
    input reg_req,
    input reg_rd_wr_L,
    input [31:0] reg_addr,
    input [31:0] reg_wr_data,
    input core_reg_ack,
    input [31:0] core_reg_rd_data,
    input udp_reg_ack,
    input [31:0] udp_reg_rd_data,
    input clk,
    input reset,
    output reg reg_ack,
    output reg [31:0] reg_rd_data,
    output reg core_reg_req,
    output reg core_reg_rd_wr_L,
    output reg [31:0] core_reg_addr,
    output reg [31:0] core_reg_wr_data,
    output reg udp_reg_req,
    output reg udp_reg_rd_wr_L,
    output reg [31:0] udp_reg_addr,
    output reg [31:0] udp_reg_wr_data
);

// Address decoding parameters: Upper 2 bits determine the path
localparam CORE_PREFIX = 2'b10;
localparam UDP_PREFIX  = 2'b11;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
        // Synchronous reset
        reg_ack <= 1'b0;
        reg_rd_data <= 32'h0;
        core_reg_req <= 1'b0;
        core_reg_rd_wr_L <= 1'b1;
        core_reg_addr <= 32'h0;
        core_reg_wr_data <= 32'h0;
        udp_reg_req <= 1'b0;
        udp_reg_rd_wr_L <= 1'b1;
        udp_reg_addr <= 32'h0;
        udp_reg_wr_data <= 32'h0;
    end else begin
        // Default outputs
        reg_ack <= 1'b0;
        reg_rd_data <= 32'h0;

        // Check for completion of core/udp requests
        if (core_reg_req && core_reg_ack) begin
            core_reg_req <= 1'b0;
            reg_ack <= 1'b1;
            reg_rd_data <= core_reg_rd_data;
        end else if (udp_reg_req && udp_reg_ack) begin
            udp_reg_req <= 1'b0;
            reg_ack <= 1'b1;
            reg_rd_data <= udp_reg_rd_data;
        end else begin
            // Handle new request if no pending transactions
            if (reg_req && !core_reg_req && !udp_reg_req) begin
                case (reg_addr[31:30])
                    CORE_PREFIX: begin
                        // Forward to core interface
                        core_reg_req <= 1'b1;
                        core_reg_rd_wr_L <= reg_rd_wr_L;
                        core_reg_addr <= {reg_addr[31:2], 2'b00};
                        core_reg_wr_data <= reg_wr_data;
                    end
                    UDP_PREFIX: begin
                        // Forward to UDP interface
                        udp_reg_req <= 1'b1;
                        udp_reg_rd_wr_L <= reg_rd_wr_L;
                        udp_reg_addr <= {reg_addr[31:2], 2'b00};
                        udp_reg_wr_data <= reg_wr_data;
                    end
                    default: begin
                        // Handle invalid address
                        reg_ack <= 1'b1;
                        if (reg_rd_wr_L) begin
                            reg_rd_data <= 32'hDEAD_BEEF;
                        end
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    end
end

endmodule
</verilog>

module packet_router (
    // Global inputs
    input  wire         clk,            
    input  wire         reset_b,        
    // Port address registers
    input wire  [07:00] address_port_0, 
    input wire  [07:00] address_port_1, 
    input wire  [07:00] address_port_2, 
    input wire  [07:00] address_port_3, 
    // Input port
    input  wire         data_stall,     
    input  wire         data_valid,     
    input  wire [07:00] data,           
    // Output ports
    output reg          ready_0,        
    output reg  [07:00] port0,          
    output reg          ready_1,        
    output reg  [07:00] port1,          
    output reg          ready_2,        
    output reg  [07:00] port2,          
    output reg          ready_3,        
    output reg  [07:00] port3          
);

    // State definitions
    localparam IDLE    = 1'b0;
    localparam ROUTING = 1'b1;
    reg state;

    // Current packet address and matching info
    reg [7:0] curr_addr;
    reg addr_match;
    reg [1:0] selected_port;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_b) begin
        if (!reset_b) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            curr_addr <= 8'h00;
            addr_match <= 1'b0;
            selected_port <= 2'd4; // Invalid port
            // Reset outputs
            ready_0 <= 1'b0; port0 <= 8'h00;
            ready_1 <= 1'b0; port1 <= 8'h00;
            ready_2 <= 1'b0; port2 <= 8'h00;
            ready_3 <= 1'b0; port3 <= 8'h00;
        end else begin
            // Default ready signals to 0
            ready_0 <= 1'b0;
            ready_1 <= 1'b0;
            ready_2 <= 1'b0;
            ready_3 <= 1'b0;

            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (data_valid && !data_stall) begin
                        curr_addr <= data;
                        // Check address match
                        if (data == address_port_0) begin
                            addr_match <= 1'b1;
                            selected_port <= 2'd0;
                        end else if (data == address_port_1) begin
                            addr_match <= 1'b1;
                            selected_port <= 2'd1;
                        end else if (data == address_port_2) begin
                            addr_match <= 1'b1;
                            selected_port <= 2'd2;
                        end else if (data == address_port_3) begin
                            addr_match <= 1'b1;
                            selected_port <= 2'd3;
                        end else begin
                            addr_match <= 1'b0;
                            selected_port <= 2'd4;
                        end
                        state <= ROUTING;

                        // Output first byte if matched
                        if (addr_match) begin
                            case (selected_port)
                                2'd0: begin port0 <= data; ready_0 <= 1'b1; end
                                2'd1: begin port1 <= data; ready_1 <= 1'b1; end
                                2'd2: begin port2 <= data; ready_2 <= 1'b1; end
                                2'd3: begin port3 <= data; ready_3 <= 1'b1; end
                            endcase
                        end
                    end
                end

                ROUTING: begin
                    if (data_valid && !data_stall) begin
                        if (addr_match) begin
                            case (selected_port)
                                2'd0: begin port0 <= data; ready_0 <= 1'b1; end
                                2'd1: begin port1 <= data; ready_1 <= 1'b1; end
                                2'd2: begin port2 <= data; ready_2 <= 1'b1; end
                                2'd3: begin port3 <= data; ready_3 <= 1'b1; end
                            endcase
                        end
                        // Remain in ROUTING state for subsequent bytes
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

localparam H_SYNC    = 96;   // Sync pulse
localparam H_BACK    = 48;   // Back porch

reg [9:0] v_count;           // Vertical counter (0-524)

assign y = v_count;

    parameter bit_rate = 1_000_000,  // Default bit rate (1 Mbps)
    parameter clk_freq = 100_000_000 // Reference clock frequency (100 MHz)

    input  data_in,   // Input data stream
    input  clk_ref,   // Reference clock
    output data_out,  // Recovered data
    output clk_out    // Recovered clock
);

localparam integer N = clk_freq / bit_rate;         // Clock cycles per bit
localparam integer N_HALF = N / 2;                  // Mid-point of bit period

reg [31:0] cnt = 0;                 // Phase counter
reg clk_out_reg = 0;                 // Recovered clock register
reg data_in_prev = 0;                // Previous data for transition detection
reg data_out_reg = 0;                // Recovered data register
reg prev_clk_out = 0;                // For edge detection

always @(posedge clk_ref) begin
    // Store previous data for transition detection
    data_in_prev <= data_in;

    // Phase adjustment logic
    if (data_in != data_in_prev) begin     // Transition detected
        cnt <= N_HALF;                     // Align phase to mid-point
    end else begin                         // Normal counting
        cnt <= (cnt == N-1) ? 0 : cnt + 1;

    // Generate recovered clock (50% duty cycle)
    clk_out_reg <= (cnt < N_HALF) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;

    // Detect rising edge of recovered clock for sampling
    prev_clk_out <= clk_out_reg;
    if (~prev_clk_out && clk_out_reg) begin
        data_out_reg <= data_in;

assign data_out = data_out_reg;

reg cd_intermediate;
reg a_pipe1, a_pipe2;
reg b_pipe1, b_pipe2;

    case ({SEL2, SEL1})

        2'b01: cd_intermediate = C | D;
        2'b10: cd_intermediate = C ^ D;
        2'b11: cd_intermediate = ~(C ^ D);

end

    if (EN) begin
        // Select signal pipeline
        sel_pipe1 <= {SEL2, SEL1};
        sel_pipe2 <= sel_pipe1;
        sel_pipe3 <= sel_pipe2;

            2'b01: OUT <= b_pipe2 | cd_intermediate;

    input signed [2:0] x,
    input signed [2:0] y,
    output reg signed [5:0] z,
    output reg ready
);

// Define states
localparam IDLE = 2'b00;
localparam BUSY = 2'b01;
localparam DONE = 2'b10;

reg [1:0] state = IDLE;
reg [1:0] step;

// Internal registers
reg signed [3:0] A; // 4-bit accumulator
reg signed [2:0] Q; // 3-bit multiplier
reg Q_prev;         // Previous Q0
reg signed [3:0] M; // Multiplicand (sign-extended)

    case (state)
        IDLE: begin
            // Initialize registers and start computation
            M <= {x[2], x}; // Sign-extend x to 4 bits
            Q <= y;
            A <= 4'b0;
            Q_prev <= 1'b0;
            step <= 0;
            state <= BUSY;
            ready <= 0;

                reg signed [3:0] new_A = A;

                // Booth algorithm step
                case ({Q[0], Q_prev})
                    2'b01: new_A = A + M;
                    2'b10: new_A = A - M;

                Q_prev <= Q[0];              // Shift out Q's LSB

            z <= {A[2:0], Q};
            ready <= 1'b1;
            state <= IDLE;

Output:
- `out`: The generated output signal.

- `M`: An integer representing a division factor.
- `C`: An integer representing the number of bits used for internal phase and control signals.

Internally, the module should contain logic that conceptually implements the functions of a Phase/Frequency Detector (PFD), a Charge Pump, a Loop Filter, a Voltage Controlled Oscillator (VCO), and a Frequency Divider. These components should interact using internal state variables to attempt to generate an output signal (`out`) whose frequency is related to the reference clock (`ref_clk`) based on the parameters N and M, using `out_clk` for feedback comparison within the loop.

module PLL #(parameter N=1, M=1, C=8) (
    input ref_clk,
    input out_clk,
    output reg out
);

reg [C-1:0] control = 0;  // Combined charge pump and loop filter state
reg [C-1:0] vco_counter = 0;
reg ref_prev = 0, out_prev = 0;
reg up = 0, down = 0;

// Phase Frequency Detector (PFD)
always @(posedge ref_clk, posedge out_clk) begin
    // Detect reference clock rising edge
    if (ref_clk && !ref_prev) begin
        if (!out_prev) up <= 1;  // Ref leads feedback
        ref_prev <= 1;
    end 
    else if (!ref_clk) begin
        ref_prev <= 0;
    end

    // Detect feedback clock rising edge
    if (out_clk && !out_prev) begin
        if (ref_prev) down <= 1;  // Feedback leads ref
        out_prev <= 1;
    end 
    else if (!out_clk) begin
        out_prev <= 0;
    end
end

// Charge Pump and Loop Filter
always @(posedge ref_clk) begin
    if (up) begin
        control <= control + M;
        up <= 0;
    end
    else if (down) begin
        control <= control - N;
        down <= 0;
    end
end

// Voltage Controlled Oscillator (VCO)
always @(posedge ref_clk) begin
    if (control == 0) begin
        vco_counter <= 1;  // Prevent division by zero
    end else begin
        vco_counter <= vco_counter + 1;
    end

    if (vco_counter >= ((1 << (C-2)) / (control + 1))) begin
        out <= ~out;
        vco_counter <= 0;
    end
end

endmodule
</verilog>

    input [3:0] b,
    input cin,
    output [3:0] sum,

  localparam H_FP    = 16;
  localparam H_RT    = 96;

  localparam V_FP    = 10;
  localparam V_RT    = 2;
  localparam V_BP    = 33;
  localparam V_TOTAL = V_DISP + V_FP + V_RT + V_BP;

  localparam V_SYNC_START = V_DISP + V_FP;

9.  An active-low reset (`ARESETN`) should return the module to the idle state and clear any internal state, including the accumulated sum and read/write counters.

module conware (
    input ACLK,
    input ARESETN,
    input [31:0] S_AXIS_TDATA,
    input S_AXIS_TLAST,
    input S_AXIS_TVALID,
    output reg S_AXIS_TREADY,
    input M_AXIS_TREADY,
    output reg M_AXIS_TVALID,
    output reg [31:0] M_AXIS_TDATA,
    output reg M_AXIS_TLAST
);

// Local parameters defining transaction sizes
localparam NUMBER_OF_INPUT_WORDS = 4;
localparam NUMBER_OF_OUTPUT_WORDS = 4;

// State machine encoding
localparam [1:0] IDLE  = 2'b00,
                 READ  = 2'b01,
                 WRITE = 2'b10;

reg [1:0] state;
reg [31:0] sum;
reg [31:0] input_counter;
reg [31:0] output_counter;

always @(posedge ACLK or negedge ARESETN) begin
    if (!ARESETN) begin
        // Reset all registers
        state <= IDLE;
        sum <= 0;
        input_counter <= 0;
        output_counter <= 0;
        S_AXIS_TREADY <= 0;
        M_AXIS_TVALID <= 0;
        M_AXIS_TDATA <= 0;
        M_AXIS_TLAST <= 0;
    end else begin
        M_AXIS_TLAST <= 0;  // TLAST always deasserted
        
        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                M_AXIS_TVALID <= 0;
                S_AXIS_TREADY <= 0;
                if (S_AXIS_TVALID) begin
                    // Start new transaction
                    state <= READ;
                    sum <= 0;
                    input_counter <= 0;
                    S_AXIS_TREADY <= 1;
                end
            end
            
            READ: begin
                S_AXIS_TREADY <= 1;
                if (S_AXIS_TVALID && S_AXIS_TREADY) begin
                    // Accumulate input data
                    sum <= sum + S_AXIS_TDATA;
                    input_counter <= input_counter + 1;
                    
                    if (input_counter + 1 == NUMBER_OF_INPUT_WORDS) begin
                        // Transition to output state
                        state <= WRITE;
                        S_AXIS_TREADY <= 0;
                        output_counter <= 0;
                        M_AXIS_TVALID <= 1;
                        M_AXIS_TDATA <= sum + S_AXIS_TDATA;  // Capture final sum
                    end
                end
            end
            
            WRITE: begin
                if (M_AXIS_TREADY && M_AXIS_TVALID) begin
                    output_counter <= output_counter + 1;
                    if (output_counter + 1 == NUMBER_OF_OUTPUT_WORDS) begin
                        // Return to idle after all outputs
                        state <= IDLE;
                        M_AXIS_TVALID <= 0;
                    end
                end
            end
            
            default: state <= IDLE;
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule
</verilog>

    input chipselect,
    input clk,
    input reset_n,
    input write_n,
    input [15:0] writedata,
    output irq,
    output reg [15:0] readdata
);

    localparam PERIOD = 16'hFFFF; // Fixed internal period value

    reg [15:0] counter_reg;
    reg timeout_flag;
    reg int_enable;
    wire running_status = (counter_reg != 0);
    wire reload = chipselect & ~write_n & ((address == 3'd2) || (address == 3'd3));
    wire clear_timeout = chipselect & ~write_n & (address == 3'd0);
    wire write_control = chipselect & ~write_n & (address == 3'd1);

    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            counter_reg <= PERIOD;
        end else begin
            if (reload)
                counter_reg <= PERIOD;
            else if (counter_reg == 0)
                counter_reg <= PERIOD;
            else
                counter_reg <= counter_reg - 1;
        end
    end

    // Timeout flag logic
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n)
            timeout_flag <= 0;
        else begin
            if (counter_reg == 0 && !reload)
                timeout_flag <= 1;
            if (clear_timeout)
                timeout_flag <= 0;
        end
    end

    // Interrupt enable register
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n)
            int_enable <= 0;
        else if (write_control)
            int_enable <= writedata[0];

        if (chipselect) begin
            case (address)

                3'd1: readdata = {15'b0, int_enable};
                default: readdata = 16'b0;

            readdata = 16'b0;
    end

    assign irq = timeout_flag & int_enable;

) (
    input clk,
    input reset_n,
    input write_en,
    input read_en,
    input [31:0] data_in,
    output reg [31:0] data_out,
    output empty,
    output full
);

    reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] read_ptr;

            write_ptr <= 0;
            read_ptr <= 0;
            count <= 0;

                2'b11: count <= count;

  input                               rst,

  output  reg                         o_read_activate,
  input           [23:0]              i_read_size,
  input           [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0]  i_read_data,
  output  reg                         o_read_stb,

  reg [23:0] write_count;

    input sw_in,
    input timer_ena,

);

    output reg [2:0] gnt

function [2:0] find_next_gnt;
    input [2:0] current_gnt;
    input [4:0] req;
    begin

    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    input [99:0] in,
    input valid_a,
    input select,
    input ready_b,
    input [7:0] data_in,
    output ready_a,
    output valid_b,
    output [9:0] data_out
);

    // Combinational logic block
    wire [99:0] mask = {100{select}};
    wire [99:0] and_res = in & mask;
    wire [99:0] or_res  = in | mask;
    wire [99:0] xor_res = in ^ mask;

    wire [7:0] and_byte = and_res[7:0];
    wire [7:0] or_byte  = or_res[7:0];
    wire [7:0] xor_byte = xor_res[7:0];

    wire [7:0] sum = and_byte + or_byte + xor_byte;
    wire [7:0] and_all = and_byte & or_byte & xor_byte;
    wire [7:0] intermediate = select ? and_all : sum;

    // Pipeline stage 1 registers
    reg [7:0] data_buffer;
    reg buffer_valid;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            data_buffer <= 8'b0;
            buffer_valid <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (valid_a && ready_b) begin
                data_buffer <= intermediate;
                buffer_valid <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                buffer_valid <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end

    // Accumulator stage
    reg [9:0] accumulator;
    reg [3:0] sample_counter;
    reg valid_b_reg;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            accumulator <= 10'b0;
            sample_counter <= 4'b0;
            valid_b_reg <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            valid_b_reg <= 1'b0;
            if (buffer_valid && ready_b) begin
                accumulator <= accumulator + data_buffer;
                if (sample_counter == 4'd15) begin
                    sample_counter <= 4'b0;
                    valid_b_reg <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    sample_counter <= sample_counter + 1;
                end
            end
        end
    end

    // Output assignments
    assign ready_a = ready_b;
    assign valid_b = valid_b_reg;
    assign data_out = accumulator;

endmodule

  parameter n = 8
)(
  input [n-1:0] dividend,
  input [n-1:0] divisor,
  output [n-1:0] quotient,
  output [n-1:0] remainder
);
  // Convert inputs to signed for arithmetic operations

  wire signed [n-1:0] signed_divisor = divisor;
  
  // Calculate standard signed division results
  wire signed [n-1:0] std_quotient = signed_dividend / signed_divisor;

    input rst,
    input mode,
    input on_off,

    reg [3:0] inner_height;

        if (rst) begin
            color <= 24'd0;
            inner_height <= 4'd0;
            ram_data <= 48'd0;

            if (mode) begin
                // Animation mode operations
                reg [23:0] new_color = color;
                reg [3:0] new_inner_height = inner_height;

                reg [8:0] lower_threshold = 9'h1FF - upper_threshold;

                reg [23:0] lower_part = (ram_address > lower_threshold) ? new_color : 24'd0;

                // Assign output
                ram_data <= {upper_part, lower_part};

                ram_data <= on_off ? 48'hB3FFFFB3FFFF : 48'd0;

module led_sreg_driver #(
    parameter COUNT = 8,
    parameter INVERT = 0,
    parameter PRESCALE = 31
) (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [COUNT-1:0] led,
    output reg sreg_d,
    output reg sreg_ld,
    output reg sreg_clk
);

    // Input synchronization registers
    reg [COUNT-1:0] led_sync0, led_sync;
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            led_sync0 <= 0;
            led_sync <= 0;
        end else begin
            led_sync0 <= led;
            led_sync <= led_sync0;
        end
    end

    // Prescaler counter
    reg [$clog2(PRESCALE+1)-1:0] prescale_counter;
    wire enable = (prescale_counter == PRESCALE);
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) prescale_counter <= 0;
        else prescale_counter <= enable ? 0 : prescale_counter + 1;
    end

    // State machine declarations
    localparam IDLE = 2'b00;
    localparam LOAD = 2'b01;
    localparam SHIFT = 2'b10;
    reg [1:0] state = IDLE;

    // Data storage and counters
    reg [COUNT-1:0] captured_led, shift_reg;
    reg [$clog2(COUNT)-1:0] bit_counter;

    // Main state machine
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            sreg_ld <= 0;
            sreg_clk <= 0;
            sreg_d <= 0;
            captured_led <= 0;
            shift_reg <= 0;
            bit_counter <= 0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    sreg_clk <= 0;
                    sreg_ld <= 0;
                    if (led_sync != captured_led) begin
                        captured_led <= led_sync;
                        shift_reg <= led_sync;
                        state <= LOAD;
                        sreg_ld <= 1;
                    end
                end

                LOAD: begin
                    if (enable) begin
                        state <= SHIFT;
                        sreg_ld <= 0;
                        bit_counter <= 0;
                    end
                end

                SHIFT: begin
                    if (enable) begin
                        sreg_clk <= 1;
                        sreg_d <= INVERT ? ~shift_reg[COUNT-1] : shift_reg[COUNT-1];
                        shift_reg <= shift_reg << 1;
                        bit_counter <= bit_counter + 1;

                        if (bit_counter == COUNT-1) begin
                            state <= IDLE;
                            sreg_clk <= 0;
                        end
                    end else begin
                        sreg_clk <= 0;
                    end
                end

                default: state <= IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
</verilog>

module wb_bus_writer (
    input         start,
    input  [47:0] rom_data,
    input         wb_clk_i,
    input         wb_rst_i,
    input         wb_ack_i,
    output        done,
    output [15:0] rom_addr,
    output [31:0] wb_dat_o,
    output [15:0] wb_adr_o,
    output        wb_cyc_o,
    output [3:0]  wb_sel_o,
    output        wb_stb_o,
    output        wb_we_o
);

    // Termination pattern (adjust value as needed)
    localparam TERMINATION_PATTERN = 48'h000000000000;

    // States
    localparam IDLE     = 2'b00;
    localparam SEND     = 2'b01;
    localparam WAIT_ACK = 2'b10;

    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    reg [15:0] rom_addr_reg;
    reg [15:0] wb_adr_reg;
    reg [31:0] wb_dat_reg;
    reg term_flag;

    // State transition and control logic
    always @(posedge wb_clk_i) begin
        if (wb_rst_i) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            rom_addr_reg <= 16'h0;
            term_flag <= 1'b0;
            wb_adr_reg <= 16'h0;
            wb_dat_reg <= 32'h0;

            state <= next_state;

            // Capture address/data and check termination in SEND state
            if (state == SEND) begin
                wb_adr_reg <= rom_data[47:32];
                wb_dat_reg <= rom_data[31:0];
                term_flag <= (rom_data == TERMINATION_PATTERN);

                rom_addr_reg <= rom_addr_reg + 1;

            SEND: next_state = WAIT_ACK;
            WAIT_ACK: begin
                if (wb_ack_i)
                    next_state = term_flag ? IDLE : SEND;
                else
                    next_state = WAIT_ACK;
            end
            default: next_state = IDLE;
        endcase
    end

    // Wishbone control signals
    assign wb_cyc_o = (state == SEND || state == WAIT_ACK);
    assign wb_stb_o = (state == SEND || state == WAIT_ACK);
    assign wb_we_o  = (state == SEND || state == WAIT_ACK);

    assign rom_addr  = rom_addr_reg;
    assign wb_adr_o  = wb_adr_reg;
    assign wb_dat_o  = wb_dat_reg;

endmodule
</verilog>

    input quadA,
    input quadB,
    output reg [7:0] count
);

reg [1:0] phase;
reg [15:0] count_total;

    if (reset) begin
        prev_AB <= 2'b00;
        phase <= 2'b00;
        count_total <= 16'b0;
    end else begin
        reg [1:0] current_AB = {quadA, quadB};
        reg [1:0] transition = current_AB ^ prev_AB;

module eth_clockgen (
    input Clk,
    input Reset,
    input [7:0] Divider,
    output reg Mdc,
    output MdcEn,
    output MdcEn_n
);

    wire [7:0] effective_divider = (Divider < 8'd2) ? 8'd2 : Divider;
    reg [7:0] counter;

    // Counter logic
    always @(posedge Clk or posedge Reset) begin
        if (Reset) begin
            counter <= 8'd0;
        end else begin
            if (counter == (effective_divider - 8'd1)) begin
                counter <= 8'd0;

    always @(posedge Clk or posedge Reset) begin
        if (Reset) begin
            Mdc <= 1'b0;

            Mdc <= (counter < (effective_divider >> 1));

    // Enable signal assignments
    assign MdcEn = (counter == (effective_divider - 8'd1));
    assign MdcEn_n = (counter == ((effective_divider >> 1) - 8'd1));

endmodule

    output reg [15:0] oEncData
);

            A <= 8'b0;
            B <= 8'b0;
            C <= 8'b0;
            D <= 16'b0;

            A <= iData[7:0];

            C <= A ^ B;
            
            // D is previous C multiplied by 3
            D <= C * 3;

            E <= {C, D[7:0]} + {D[7:0], C};

module measure_position #(
    parameter INPUT_WIDTH = 11,
    COLOR_WIDTH = 10,
    FRAME_X_MAX = 640,
    FRAME_Y_MAX = 480,
    COUNT_THRESH = 40
) (
    input clk,
    input aresetn,
    input enable,
    input [INPUT_WIDTH-1:0] vga_x,
    input [INPUT_WIDTH-1:0] vga_y,
    input [COLOR_WIDTH-1:0] delta_frame,
    output reg [INPUT_WIDTH-1:0] x_position,
    output reg [INPUT_WIDTH-1:0] y_position,
    output reg xy_valid
);

    reg [26:0] sum_x, sum_x_next;
    reg [26:0] sum_y, sum_y_next;
    reg [18:0] count, count_next;
    wire pixel_of_interest = (delta_frame != 0);
    wire end_of_frame = (vga_x == FRAME_X_MAX) && (vga_y == FRAME_Y_MAX);

    // Combinational next state logic
    always @* begin
        sum_x_next = sum_x;
        sum_y_next = sum_y;
        count_next = count;
        if (enable && pixel_of_interest) begin
            sum_x_next = sum_x + vga_x;
            sum_y_next = sum_y + vga_y;
            count_next = count + 1;
        end
    end

    // Sequential state update
    always @(posedge clk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            sum_x <= 0;
            sum_y <= 0;
            count <= 0;
        end else if (!enable || end_of_frame) begin
            sum_x <= 0;
            sum_y <= 0;
            count <= 0;
        end else begin
            sum_x <= sum_x_next;
            sum_y <= sum_y_next;
            count <= count_next;

    // Output calculation
    always @(posedge clk or negedge aresetn) begin
        if (!aresetn) begin
            x_position <= {INPUT_WIDTH{1'b1}};
            y_position <= {INPUT_WIDTH{1'b1}};
            xy_valid <= 0;
        end else if (!enable) begin
            x_position <= {INPUT_WIDTH{1'b1}};
            y_position <= {INPUT_WIDTH{1'b1}};
            xy_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (end_of_frame) begin
                if (count_next >= COUNT_THRESH) begin
                    x_position <= sum_x_next / count_next;
                    y_position <= sum_y_next / count_next;
                end else begin
                    x_position <= {INPUT_WIDTH{1'b1}};
                    y_position <= {INPUT_WIDTH{1'b1}};
                end
                xy_valid <= 1;
            end else begin
                xy_valid <= 0;
            end
        end
    end

module KEYBOARD (
    input wire clk,
    input wire circuit_clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire [3:0] COLUMN,
    output reg [3:0] ROW,
    output reg [3:0] KEY_BUFFER,
    output wire PRESS_VALID
);

    // Scanning control
    reg [1:0] row_counter;
    wire any_press = (COLUMN != 4'b1111);
    
    // Column encoder
    reg [1:0] col_index;
    always @(*) begin
        casez (COLUMN)
            4'b???0: col_index = 2'b00;
            4'b??0?: col_index = 2'b01;
            4'b?0??: col_index = 2'b10;
            4'b0???: col_index = 2'b11;
            default: col_index = 2'b00;
        endcase
    end

    // Scan row counter
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
        if (!reset) row_counter <= 2'b00;
        else row_counter <= row_counter + 1'b1;
    end

    // Row decoder
    always @(*) begin
        case (row_counter)
            2'b00: ROW = 4'b1110;
            2'b01: ROW = 4'b1101;
            2'b10: ROW = 4'b1011;
            2'b11: ROW = 4'b0111;
            default: ROW = 4'b1111;
        endcase
    end

    // Press detection and synchronization
    reg [1:0] saved_row, saved_col;
    reg raw_press;
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
        if (!reset) begin
            saved_row <= 2'b00;
            saved_col <= 2'b00;
            raw_press <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            raw_press <= any_press;
            if (any_press) begin
                saved_row <= row_counter;
                saved_col <= col_index;
            end
        end
    end

    // Cross-clock domain synchronization
    reg [1:0] sync_press = 2'b00;
    reg [1:0] saved_row_sync, saved_col_sync;
    always @(posedge circuit_clk or negedge reset) begin
        if (!reset) begin
            sync_press <= 2'b00;
            saved_row_sync <= 2'b00;
            saved_col_sync <= 2'b00;
        end else begin
            sync_press <= {sync_press[0], raw_press};
            if (sync_press[0] & ~sync_press[1]) begin
                saved_row_sync <= saved_row;
                saved_col_sync <= saved_col;
            end
        end
    end

    // Debounce counter
    reg [3:0] debounce_cnt;
    reg press_valid;
    always @(posedge circuit_clk or negedge reset) begin
        if (!reset) begin
            debounce_cnt <= 4'b0000;
            press_valid <= 1'b0;
            KEY_BUFFER <= 4'b0000;
        end else begin
            press_valid <= 1'b0;
            if (sync_press[1]) begin
                if (debounce_cnt == 4'b1111) begin
                    press_valid <= 1'b1;
                    KEY_BUFFER <= {saved_row_sync, saved_col_sync};
                end
                else debounce_cnt <= debounce_cnt + 1'b1;
            end else begin
                debounce_cnt <= 4'b0000;
            end
        end
    end

    assign PRESS_VALID = press_valid;

endmodule

module _4bit_binary_multiplier (
    input start,
    input clk,
    input [3:0] multiplier_address,
    input [3:0] multiplicand_address,
    output reg [7:0] p,
    output reg done
);

    reg [3:0] multiplier;
    reg [3:0] multiplicand;
    reg [7:0] product;
    reg [2:0] step;
    reg [1:0] state;

    localparam IDLE = 2'b00;
    localparam RUN = 2'b01;
    localparam FINISH = 2'b10;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        case (state)
            IDLE: begin
                done <= 0;
                if (start) begin
                    multiplier <= multiplier_address;
                    multiplicand <= multiplicand_address;
                    product <= 0;
                    step <= 0;
                    state <= RUN;
                end
            end
            RUN: begin
                if (step < 4) begin
                    case (step)
                        0: begin
                            if (multiplier[0]) 
                                product <= product + ({{4{multiplicand[3]}, multiplicand} << 0);
                            step <= step + 1;
                        end
                        1: begin
                            if (multiplier[1]) 
                                product <= product + ({{4{multiplicand[3]}, multiplicand} << 1);
                            step <= step + 1;
                        end
                        2: begin
                            if (multiplier[2]) 
                                product <= product + ({{4{multiplicand[3]}, multiplicand} << 2);
                            step <= step + 1;
                        end
                        3: begin
                            if (multiplier[3]) 
                                product <= product - ({{4{multiplicand[3]}, multiplicand} << 3);
                            step <= step + 1;
                        end
                    endcase
                end else begin
                    state <= FINISH;
                end
            end
            FINISH: begin
                p <= product;
                done <= 1;
                state <= IDLE;
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule

    input clk,
    input reset,
    input ped_cross,
    output reg green,
    output reg yellow,
    output reg red,
    output reg ped_red,
    output reg ped_green
);

    // State definitions
    localparam [2:0] 
        CAR_GREEN   = 3'd0,
        CAR_YELLOW  = 3'd1,
        CAR_RED     = 3'd2,
        PED_DELAY1  = 3'd3,
        PED_GREEN   = 3'd4,
        PED_DELAY2  = 3'd5;

    // Timing parameters (adjust values as needed)
    localparam T_GREEN       = 30;
    localparam T_YELLOW      = 5;
    localparam T_RED         = 20;
    localparam T_PED_DELAY1  = 5;
    localparam T_PED_GREEN   = 10;
    localparam T_PED_DELAY2  = 5;

    reg [2:0] current_state, next_state;
    reg [31:0] counter;
    reg ped_request;

    // State transition and counter logic
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            current_state <= CAR_GREEN;
            counter <= T_GREEN;
            ped_request <= 0;
        end else begin
            // Update current_state and counter
            if (counter == 0) begin
                current_state <= next_state;
                // Load counter for next state
                case (next_state)
                    CAR_GREEN:  counter <= T_GREEN;
                    CAR_YELLOW: counter <= T_YELLOW;
                    CAR_RED:    counter <= T_RED;
                    PED_DELAY1: counter <= T_PED_DELAY1;
                    PED_GREEN:  counter <= T_PED_GREEN;
                    PED_DELAY2: counter <= T_PED_DELAY2;

            CAR_YELLOW:  next_state = (counter == 0) ? CAR_RED : CAR_YELLOW;
            CAR_RED:     next_state = (counter == 0) ? (ped_request ? PED_DELAY1 : CAR_GREEN) : CAR_RED;
            PED_DELAY1:  next_state = (counter == 0) ? PED_GREEN : PED_DELAY1;
            PED_GREEN:   next_state = (counter == 0) ? PED_DELAY2 : PED_GREEN;
            PED_DELAY2:  next_state = (counter == 0) ? CAR_GREEN : PED_DELAY2;
            default:     next_state = CAR_GREEN;
        endcase
    end

    // Output logic
    always @* begin
        green = 0;
        yellow = 0;
        red = 0;
        ped_red = 0;
        ped_green = 0;

        case (current_state)
            CAR_GREEN: begin
                green = 1;
                ped_red = 1;

            CAR_YELLOW: begin
                yellow = 1;
                ped_red = 1;
            end
            CAR_RED: begin

                ped_red = 1;

            PED_DELAY1: ped_red = 1;
            PED_GREEN:  ped_green = 1;
            PED_DELAY2: ped_red = 1;
            default: ; // Defaults already set
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module i2s_shift_in (
    input clk,
    input reset_n,
    input fifo_ready,
    input enable,
    input bclk,
    input lrclk,
    input data_in,
    output reg [31:0] fifo_right_data,
    output reg [31:0] fifo_left_data,
    output reg fifo_write
);

    // Synchronize bclk and lrclk to clk domain
    reg [1:0] bclk_sync;
    reg [1:0] lrclk_sync;
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            bclk_sync <= 2'b00;
            lrclk_sync <= 2'b00;
        end else begin
            bclk_sync <= {bclk_sync[0], bclk};
            lrclk_sync <= {lrclk_sync[0], lrclk};
        end
    end

    // Detect rising edge of synchronized bclk
    wire bclk_rising = bclk_sync[1] && ~bclk_sync[0];

    // Detect transition of synchronized lrclk and previous state
    wire lrclk_changed = lrclk_sync[1] ^ lrclk_sync[0];
    wire prev_lrclk = lrclk_sync[1];

    // Shift register for incoming data (MSB first)
    reg [31:0] shift_reg;
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            shift_reg <= 32'b0;
        end else if (bclk_rising) begin
            shift_reg <= {data_in, shift_reg[31:1]}; // Shift right, MSB first
        end
    end

    // Capture left/right data on lrclk transition
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            fifo_left_data <= 32'b0;
            fifo_right_data <= 32'b0;
        end else if (lrclk_changed) begin
            if (prev_lrclk) begin
                fifo_left_data <= shift_reg; // Previous was left channel
            end else begin
                fifo_right_data <= shift_reg; // Previous was right channel
            end
        end
    end

    // Track received left and right data
    reg left_received, right_received;
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            left_received <= 1'b0;
            right_received <= 1'b0;
            fifo_write <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            fifo_write <= 1'b0;
            if (left_received && right_received && enable && fifo_ready) begin
                fifo_write <= 1'b1;
                left_received <= 1'b0;
                right_received <= 1'b0;
            end else if (lrclk_changed) begin
                if (prev_lrclk) begin
                    left_received <= 1'b1;
                end else begin
                    right_received <= 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

2.  Maintain a counter that increments on every clock cycle where the `stall` input is high. Let's call this the 'stalled cycle counter'.

Update the outputs `ipc` and `cpi` synchronously based on the current counter values:

- `cpi` should be calculated as the number of non-stalled cycles ('total cycle counter' minus 'stalled cycle counter') divided by the 'cycle-based count'.

module video_sys_CPU_nios2_performance_monitors (

    input reset,
    input [31:0] inst,
    input stall,
    output reg [31:0] ipc,
    output reg [31:0] cpi
);

    reg [31:0] stalled_cycle_counter;
    reg [31:0] cycle_based_count;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            total_cycle_counter <= 0;
            stalled_cycle_counter <= 0;
            cycle_based_count <= 0;
            ipc <= 0;
            cpi <= 0;

            reg [31:0] total_next = total_cycle_counter + 1;
            reg [31:0] stalled_next = stalled_cycle_counter + (stall ? 1 : 0);
            reg [31:0] cycle_next = cycle_based_count + 1;

            // Compute non-stalled cycles
            reg [31:0] non_stalled = total_next - stalled_next;

            // Calculate IPC

            else
                ipc <= cycle_next / non_stalled;

            // Calculate CPI

            stalled_cycle_counter <= stalled_next;

    input rst,
    output reg [9:0] hcount,
    output reg [9:0] vcount,
    output hsync,
    output vsync,
    output blnk
);

// Configurable timing parameters (example values for 640x480@60Hz)
localparam H_ACTIVE = 640;      // Horizontal active pixels
localparam H_FP = 16;          // Horizontal front porch
localparam H_SYNC = 96;        // Horizontal sync pulse width
localparam H_BP = 48;          // Horizontal back porch
localparam H_TOTAL = H_ACTIVE + H_FP + H_SYNC + H_BP;  // Total horizontal pixels

localparam V_ACTIVE = 480;     // Vertical active lines
localparam V_FP = 10;          // Vertical front porch
localparam V_SYNC = 2;         // Vertical sync pulse width
localparam V_BP = 33;          // Vertical back porch
localparam V_TOTAL = V_ACTIVE + V_FP + V_SYNC + V_BP;  // Total vertical lines

localparam H_SYNC_START = H_ACTIVE + H_FP;    // Start of horizontal sync
localparam H_SYNC_END = H_SYNC_START + H_SYNC;// End of horizontal sync
localparam V_SYNC_START = V_ACTIVE + V_FP;    // Start of vertical sync
localparam V_SYNC_END = V_SYNC_START + V_SYNC;// End of vertical sync

localparam HSYNC_POL = 1'b0;   // Horizontal sync polarity (0 = active low)
localparam VSYNC_POL = 1'b0;   // Vertical sync polarity (0 = active low)

// Horizontal and vertical counters
always @(posedge pclk) begin
    if (rst) begin
        hcount <= 10'd0;
        vcount <= 10'd0;
    end else begin
        if (hcount == H_TOTAL - 1) begin
            hcount <= 10'd0;
            if (vcount == V_TOTAL - 1)
                vcount <= 10'd0;
            else
                vcount <= vcount + 10'd1;
        end else begin
            hcount <= hcount + 10'd1;
        end
    end
end

// Sync signal generation
assign hsync = (hcount >= H_SYNC_START && hcount < H_SYNC_END) ? HSYNC_POL : ~HSYNC_POL;
assign vsync = (vcount >= V_SYNC_START && vcount < V_SYNC_END) ? VSYNC_POL : ~VSYNC_POL;

// Blanking signal generation (active low during display area)
assign blnk = (hcount < H_ACTIVE && vcount < V_ACTIVE) ? 1'b0 : 1'b1;

endmodule
</verilog>

module spi2 (

    input sdi,
    output reg bsync,
    input start,
    output reg rdy,
    input [1:0] speed,
    input [7:0] din,
    output reg [7:0] dout
);

reg [2:0] bit_cnt;
reg [7:0] tx_reg;
reg [7:0] rx_reg;
reg [3:0] sck_counter;
reg sck_prev;
reg state;

localparam IDLE = 0;
localparam RUN = 1;

always @(posedge clock) begin
    sck_prev <= sck;
    case (state)
        IDLE: begin
            rdy <= 1'b1;
            sck <= 1'b0;
            bsync <= 1'b0;
            sck_counter <= 4'b0;
            if (start) begin
                state <= RUN;
                tx_reg <= din;
                bit_cnt <= 3'd7;
                rx_reg <= 8'b0;
                rdy <= 1'b0;
                bsync <= 1'b1;
            end

        RUN: begin
            rdy <= 1'b0;
            if (sck_counter == ((1 << speed) - 1)) begin
                sck_counter <= 4'b0;
                sck <= ~sck;
            end else begin
                sck_counter <= sck_counter + 1;

                sdo <= tx_reg[7];
                tx_reg <= {tx_reg[6:0], 1'b0};
                if (bit_cnt == 3'd7) begin
                    bsync <= 1'b0;

                bit_cnt <= bit_cnt - 1;
                if (bit_cnt == 3'd0) begin
                    dout <= {rx_reg[6:0], sdi};
                    state <= IDLE;
                end
            end
        end
    endcase
end

endmodule

module FpuFp64_Mul (
    input wire clk,
    input wire enable,
    input wire [63:0] srca,
    input wire [63:0] srcb,
    output reg [63:0] dst
);

wire sign_a = srca[63];
wire sign_b = srcb[63];
wire sign_result = sign_a ^ sign_b;

wire [10:0] exp_a = srca[62:52];
wire [10:0] exp_b = srcb[62:52];
wire [51:0] mantissa_a = srca[51:0];
wire [51:0] mantissa_b = srcb[51:0];

// Detect zero inputs
wire a_zero = (exp_a == 0) && (mantissa_a == 0);
wire b_zero = (exp_b == 0) && (mantissa_b == 0);
wire any_zero = a_zero || b_zero;

// Extract significands with implicit leading 1
wire [52:0] sig_a = {1'b1, mantissa_a};
wire [52:0] sig_b = {1'b1, mantissa_b};

// Significand multiplication with conditional precision
`ifdef PRECISE_FMUL
    wire [107:0] product_full = {1'b0, sig_a} * {1'b0, sig_b};
    wire [105:0] product_sig = product_full[107:2];
`else
    wire [105:0] product_sig = sig_a * sig_b;
`endif

// Determine normalization shift
wire shift_needed = product_sig[105]; // Check if product >=2

// Calculate exponent adjustments
wire [11:0] exp_sum = exp_a + exp_b;
wire signed [12:0] exp_initial = $signed(exp_sum) - 13'd1023;
wire signed [12:0] exp_shifted = exp_initial + 13'd1;
wire signed [12:0] exp_unbiased = shift_needed ? exp_shifted : exp_initial;

// Handle overflow/underflow
wire overflow = (exp_unbiased >= 13'sd2047);
wire underflow = (exp_unbiased <= 13'sd0);

// Calculate final exponent
wire [10:0] final_exp;
assign final_exp = overflow  ? 11'h7FF :
                   underflow ? 11'h0 :
                   exp_unbiased[10:0];

// Normalize significand
wire [105:0] shifted_sig = {1'b0, product_sig[105:1]};
wire [51:0] final_mantissa;
assign final_mantissa = shift_needed ? shifted_sig[103:52] : product_sig[103:52];

// Assemble final result
wire [63:0] result;
assign result = any_zero ? {sign_result, 63'd0} :
                overflow ? {sign_result, 11'h7FF, 52'd0} :
                underflow ? {sign_result, 63'd0} :
                {sign_result, final_exp, final_mantissa};

// Register output
always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (enable) dst <= result;
end

endmodule
</verilog>

module debounce_switch #(
    parameter WIDTH = 1,
    parameter N = 3,
    parameter RATE = 125000
) (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] in,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] out
);

    reg [31:0] count;

    // Counter logic
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            count <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (count == RATE - 1)
                count <= 0;
            else
                count <= count + 1;

        genvar i;
        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1) begin : gen_debounce
            reg [N-1:0] shift_reg;
            reg out_bit;

            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin

                    out_bit <= 1'b0;

                            out_bit <= 1'b0;

module mmu_table_load (
    input  wire         iCLOCK,
    input  wire         inRESET,
    input  wire         iRESET_SYNC,
    input  wire         iLD_REQ,
    input  wire [31:0]  iLD_ADDR,
    input  wire         iMEM_LOCK,
    input  wire         iMEM_VALID,
    input  wire [63:0]  iMEM_DATA,
    output wire         oLD_BUSY,
    output wire         oMEM_REQ,
    output wire [31:0]  oMEM_ADDR,
    output wire         oDONE_VALID,
    output wire [31:0]  oDONE_DATA,
    output wire [11:0]  oDONE_FLAG0,
    output wire [11:0]  oDONE_FLAG1
);

    localparam [1:0] IDLE      = 2'b00,
                     REQUEST   = 2'b01,
                     WAIT_DATA = 2'b10;

    reg [1:0]  current_state, next_state;
    reg [31:0] captured_addr;

    always @(posedge iCLOCK or negedge inRESET) begin
        if (!inRESET) begin
            current_state <= IDLE;
            captured_addr <= 32'b0;
        end else if (iRESET_SYNC) begin
            current_state <= IDLE;
            captured_addr <= 32'b0;
        end else begin
            current_state <= next_state;
            if (current_state == IDLE && next_state == REQUEST)
                captured_addr <= iLD_ADDR;
        end

        next_state = current_state;
        case (current_state)
            IDLE: begin
                if (iLD_REQ)
                    next_state = REQUEST;
            end
            REQUEST: begin
                if (!iMEM_LOCK)
                    next_state = WAIT_DATA;
            end
            WAIT_DATA: begin
                if (iMEM_VALID)
                    next_state = IDLE;
            end
            default: next_state = IDLE;
        endcase
    end

    assign oLD_BUSY = (current_state != IDLE);
    assign oMEM_REQ = (current_state == REQUEST);
    assign oMEM_ADDR = (current_state == REQUEST) ? captured_addr : 32'b0;
    assign oDONE_VALID = (current_state == WAIT_DATA) && iMEM_VALID;
    assign oDONE_DATA = captured_addr[2] ? iMEM_DATA[63:32] : iMEM_DATA[31:0];
    assign oDONE_FLAG0 = iMEM_DATA[11:0];
    assign oDONE_FLAG1 = iMEM_DATA[43:32];

endmodule
</verilog>

    input mrd_start_i,

    input [31:0] mrd_tlp_sent_i,

    input rd_metering_i,
    input [5:0] trn_tbuf_av_i,

    output reg mwr_start_fc_o

    input CHANNEL_UP,
    output reg WARN_CC,

);

localparam COUNTING  = 3'b001;
localparam WARN      = 3'b010;
localparam DO_CC_ST  = 3'b011;
localparam DONE      = 3'b100;

The module should implement a counter system with the following behavior:

2.  The core logic operates primarily on the `clk` domain. It detects a specific event related to the `pulse` input. This event occurs when the `pulse` signal, after transitioning high, remains low for a minimum required duration (a fixed number of `clk` cycles).
3.  An internal mechanism should track the occurrences of this detected event. The `mileage` counter should increment only on every *second* successful detection of this event. `mileage` is a 12-bit counter.
4.  The `number_of_halfkm` counter (12 bits) should increment based on the value of `mileage`. Specifically, it increments whenever the `mileage` value is equal to 4 less than any multiple of 5 (i.e., 4, 9, 14, 19, ...).
5.  An internal flag or signal should indicate the completion of the logic that potentially increments `mileage`.
6.  A separate output signal, `work`, should be generated on the `clk_1` domain. This signal should produce a pulse of a specific, short duration (a fixed number of `clk_1` cycles) whenever the internal flag indicating completion (from step 5) transitions low.

Implement the module based on this functional description, using the specified interface and module name. The exact durations and counts mentioned as "fixed number" should be determined based on a reasonable design choice that fulfills the described behavior.

<verilog>
module round_counter_module (
    input wire pulse,
    input wire reset,
    input wire clk,
    input wire clk_1,
    output reg work,
    output reg [11:0] mileage,
    output reg [11:0] number_of_halfkm
);

// Parameters
localparam MIN_LOW_CYCLES = 16; // Minimum low duration after rising edge

// Pulse event detection
reg pulse_prev;
always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) pulse_prev <= 1'b0;
    else pulse_prev <= pulse;
end
wire pulse_rising = ~pulse_prev & pulse;

reg [4:0] low_counter; // Count up to 31 (sufficient for 16 cycles)
reg counting;

// Low duration counter logic
always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) begin
        counting <= 1'b0;
        low_counter <= 5'b0;
    end else begin
        if (pulse_rising) begin
            counting <= 1'b1;
            low_counter <= 5'b0;
        end else if (counting) begin
            if (pulse) begin
                // Pulse went high again, reset
                counting <= 1'b0;
                low_counter <= 5'b0;
            end else begin
                low_counter <= low_counter + 1;
                if (low_counter == MIN_LOW_CYCLES-1) begin
                    counting <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end else begin
            low_counter <= 5'b0;
        end
    end
end

wire event_detected = (low_counter == MIN_LOW_CYCLES-1) && ~counting;

// Two-event toggle for mileage increment
reg event_toggle;
always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) event_toggle <= 1'b0;
    else if (event_detected) event_toggle <= ~event_toggle;
end

reg event_toggle_prev;
always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) event_toggle_prev <= 1'b0;
    else event_toggle_prev <= event_toggle;
end

wire mileage_inc = event_toggle_prev & ~event_toggle;

// Mileage counter
always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) mileage <= 12'b0;
    else if (mileage_inc) mileage <= mileage + 1;
end

// Number of halfkm increment logic
wire [11:0] new_mileage = mileage + 1;
wire number_of_halfkm_inc = mileage_inc && (new_mileage % 5 == 4);

always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) number_of_halfkm <= 12'b0;
    else if (number_of_halfkm_inc) number_of_halfkm <= number_of_halfkm + 1;
end

// Work signal generation in clk_1 domain
reg flag_mileage_complete;
always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) flag_mileage_complete <= 1'b0;
    else flag_mileage_complete <= mileage_inc;
end

// Synchronizer and edge detection
reg [2:0] sync_chain;
always @(posedge clk_1 or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) sync_chain <= 3'b0;
    else sync_chain <= {sync_chain[1:0], flag_mileage_complete};
end

wire flag_falling = (sync_chain[2:1] == 2'b10);

// Generate 1-cycle work pulse
always @(posedge clk_1 or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) work <= 1'b0;
    else work <= flag_falling;
end

endmodule
</verilog>

    input [1:0] washing_machine_running,
    output reg push,
    output reg [2:0] sel_value

        sel_value = LO;
        initialized = 0;

            sel_value <= LO;
            push <= 0;
            initialized <= 0;

2.  A "Hold" mode where the output `Q` retains the value that input `D` had just before entering this mode.
3.  Another "Hold" mode which also retains a value.

Transitions between these modes (when `RESET_B` is high) are controlled by inputs `SCD` and `SCE`:
*   From the reset state (when `RESET_B` transitions from low to high), the module enters the "Pass-Through" mode.
*   From the "Pass-Through" mode: A control signal `SCD` determines the next mode. If `SCD` is high, transition to the first "Hold" mode. If `SCD` is low, remain in "Pass-Through".
*   From the first "Hold" mode: The same control signal `SCD` determines the next mode. If `SCD` is low, transition back to the "Pass-Through" mode. If `SCD` is high, remain in this "Hold" mode.
*   There is another mode which also holds data. When in this mode, a different control signal `SCE` determines the next mode. If `SCE` is low, transition back to the "Pass-Through" mode. If `SCE` is high, remain in this mode.

module data_control (
    output reg Q,
    input CLK_N,
    input D,
    input SCD,
    input SCE,
    input RESET_B
);

    // Define states
    localparam RESET_ST = 2'b00;
    localparam PASS_THROUGH = 2'b01;
    localparam HOLD_SCD = 2'b10;
    localparam HOLD_SCE = 2'b11;

    reg [1:0] current_state, next_state;
    reg stored_value;

    // State transition and storage
    always @(negedge CLK_N, negedge RESET_B) begin
        if (!RESET_B) begin
            current_state <= RESET_ST;
            Q <= 1'b0;
            stored_value <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            current_state <= next_state;
            
            // Store D when entering PASS_THROUGH
            if (current_state == RESET_ST || next_state == PASS_THROUGH)
                stored_value <= D;
        end
    end

    // Next state logic
    always @(*) begin
        case (current_state)
            RESET_ST: next_state = PASS_THROUGH;
            
            PASS_THROUGH: 
                next_state = SCD ? HOLD_SCD : PASS_THROUGH;
            
            HOLD_SCD: 
                next_state = SCD ? HOLD_SCD : PASS_THROUGH;
            
            HOLD_SCE: 
                next_state = SCE ? HOLD_SCE : PASS_THROUGH;
            
            default: next_state = RESET_ST;
        endcase
    end

    // Output logic
    always @(*) begin
        case (current_state)
            RESET_ST:    Q = 1'b0;
            PASS_THROUGH: Q = D;
            HOLD_SCD:    Q = stored_value;
            HOLD_SCE:    Q = stored_value;
            default:     Q = 1'b0;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
</verilog>

module axi_protocol_converter_v2_1_13_b2s_wr_cmd_fsm (
    input  wire        clk,
    input  wire        reset,
    input  wire        s_awvalid,
    input  wire        m_awready,
    input  wire        next_pending,
    input  wire        b_full,
    output reg         s_awready,
    output reg         m_awvalid,
    output reg         next,
    output reg         b_push,
    output reg         a_push
);

    // State definitions
    localparam [1:0]
        IDLE                  = 2'b00,
        ISSUE_CMD             = 2'b01,
        CMD_ACCEPTED_PENDING  = 2'b10,
        DONE_WAIT             = 2'b11;

    reg [1:0] state, next_state;

    // Sequential state transition
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= IDLE;
        end else begin
            state <= next_state;
        end
    end

    // Combinational next state and output logic

        next_state = state;
        s_awready = 1'b0;
        m_awvalid = 1'b0;
        next = 1'b0;
        b_push = 1'b0;
        a_push = 1'b0;

                a_push = 1'b1;
                if (s_awvalid) begin
                    next_state = ISSUE_CMD;
                end

            ISSUE_CMD: begin
                m_awvalid = 1'b1;

                    if (next_pending) begin

            CMD_ACCEPTED_PENDING: begin
                next = 1'b1;
                next_state = ISSUE_CMD;

            DONE_WAIT: begin
                if (!b_full) begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                    s_awready = 1'b1;
                    b_push = 1'b1;
                    next = 1'b1;
                end
            end
            default: begin
                next_state = IDLE;

localparam OUT  = 2'b10;

reg signed [15:0] B_reg;
reg signed [31:0] P_reg;

module SensorFSM #(
  parameter DataWidth = 8
) (
  input                        Reset_n_i,
  input                        Clk_i,
  input                        Enable_i,
  output reg                   CpuIntr_o,
  output     [2*DataWidth-1:0] SensorValue_o,
  output reg                   MeasureFSM_Start_o,
  input                        MeasureFSM_Done_i,
  input     [DataWidth-1:0]    MeasureFSM_Byte0_i,
  input     [DataWidth-1:0]    MeasureFSM_Byte1_i,
  input [2*DataWidth-1:0]      ParamThreshold_i,
  input [2*DataWidth-1:0]      ParamCounterPreset_i
);

  // State encoding
  localparam [2:0]
    Disabled      = 3'd0,
    Idle          = 3'd1,
    Start         = 3'd2,
    WaitForDone   = 3'd3,
    ProcessData   = 3'd4;

  // Timer and data storage
  reg [2*DataWidth-1:0] timer;
  reg [2*DataWidth-1:0] stored_ref;
  reg [2*DataWidth-1:0] sensor_value;

  // Control signals
  wire load_timer = (next_state == Idle) && (current_state != Idle);
  wire [2*DataWidth-1:0] abs_diff = (sensor_value >= stored_ref) ? 
                                   (sensor_value - stored_ref) : 
                                   (stored_ref - sensor_value);
  wire diff_gt_thresh = (abs_diff > ParamThreshold_i);

  // Continuous assignments
  assign SensorValue_o = stored_ref;

  // State transition logic

    case (current_state)
      Disabled: next_state = Enable_i ? Idle : Disabled;
      Idle: begin
        if (!Enable_i)          next_state = Disabled;
        else if (timer == 0)    next_state = Start;
        else                    next_state = Idle;
      end
      Start:                    next_state = WaitForDone;
      WaitForDone:              next_state = MeasureFSM_Done_i ? ProcessData : WaitForDone;
      ProcessData:              next_state = Idle;
      default:                  next_state = Disabled;
    endcase
  end

  // Sequential state update
  always @(posedge Clk_i or negedge Reset_n_i) begin
    if (!Reset_n_i) current_state <= Disabled;
    else            current_state <= next_state;
  end

  // Timer control
  always @(posedge Clk_i or negedge Reset_n_i) begin
    if (!Reset_n_i) begin
      timer <= 0;
    end else begin
      if (load_timer)           timer <= ParamCounterPreset_i;
      else if (current_state == Idle && timer != 0)
                                timer <= timer - 1;
    end
  end

  // Data capture and processing
  always @(posedge Clk_i or negedge Reset_n_i) begin
    if (!Reset_n_i) begin
      sensor_value <= 0;
      stored_ref <= 0;
    end else begin
      // Capture sensor value when measurement done
      if (current_state == WaitForDone && MeasureFSM_Done_i)
        sensor_value <= {MeasureFSM_Byte1_i, MeasureFSM_Byte0_i};

    if (!Reset_n_i) CpuIntr_o <= 0;
    else            CpuIntr_o <= (current_state == ProcessData) && diff_gt_thresh;
  end

  // Measurement start signal
  always @(*) begin
    MeasureFSM_Start_o = (current_state == Start);
  end

endmodule

    input ctrl,

    input ps2_clk_negedge,

    output received_data_en
);

    localparam WAITING    = 2'b01;
    localparam RECEIVING  = 2'b10;

    reg [3:0] bit_counter;
    reg [7:0] shift_reg;
    reg received_data_en_reg;

            state <= IDLE;
        else
            state <= next_state;

    // Next state logic

            IDLE: begin

            shift_reg <= {ps2_data, shift_reg[7:1]};

        if (reset)
            received_data <= 8'd0;

        if (reset)
            received_data_en_reg <= 1'b0;
        else

module ST_to_MM_Adapter #(
    parameter integer DATA_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter integer BYTEENABLE_WIDTH_LOG2 = 2,
    parameter integer ADDRESS_WIDTH = 32,
    parameter integer UNALIGNED_ACCESS_ENABLE = 1
) (
    input  wire                      clk,
    input  wire                      reset,
    input  wire                      enable,
    input  wire [ADDRESS_WIDTH-1:0]  address,
    input  wire                      start,
    input  wire                      waitrequest,
    input  wire                      stall,
    input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]     fifo_data,
    input  wire                      fifo_empty,
    output reg  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0]     write_data,
    output wire                      fifo_readack
);

    localparam BYTES_PER_WORD = 1 << BYTEENABLE_WIDTH_LOG2;

    reg [1:0] state;
    localparam IDLE                 = 2'b00;
    localparam ALIGNED_READ         = 2'b01;
    localparam UNALIGNED_FIRST_READ = 2'b10;
    localparam UNALIGNED_SECOND_READ= 2'b11;

    reg [BYTEENABLE_WIDTH_LOG2-1:0] offset_reg;
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] buffer_reg;

    wire mm_ready = enable && !stall && !waitrequest;
    wire [BYTEENABLE_WIDTH_LOG2-1:0] current_offset = address[BYTEENABLE_WIDTH_LOG2-1:0];
    wire aligned = (current_offset == 0);

    // fifo_readack logic
    assign fifo_readack = ((state == ALIGNED_READ) || (state == UNALIGNED_FIRST_READ) || (state == UNALIGNED_SECOND_READ)) 
                            && mm_ready && !fifo_empty;

    // State machine and offset_reg
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            offset_reg <= 0;
            buffer_reg <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (start) begin
                offset_reg <= current_offset;
                buffer_reg <= 0;
                if (UNALIGNED_ACCESS_ENABLE && (current_offset != 0)) begin
                    state <= UNALIGNED_FIRST_READ;
                end else begin
                    state <= ALIGNED_READ;
                end
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    ALIGNED_READ: begin
                        if (fifo_readack) begin
                            state <= IDLE;
                        end
                    end
                    UNALIGNED_FIRST_READ: begin
                        if (fifo_readack) begin
                            buffer_reg <= fifo_data >> (offset_reg * 8);
                            state <= UNALIGNED_SECOND_READ;
                        end
                    end
                    UNALIGNED_SECOND_READ: begin
                        if (fifo_readack) begin
                            state <= IDLE;
                        end
                    end
                    default: state <= IDLE;
                endcase
            end
        end
    end

    // write_data logic
    always @(*) begin
        if (state == ALIGNED_READ && fifo_readack) begin
            write_data = fifo_data;
        end else if (state == UNALIGNED_SECOND_READ && fifo_readack) begin
            write_data = buffer_reg | (fifo_data << ((BYTES_PER_WORD - offset_reg) * 8));
        end else begin
            write_data = 0;
        end
    end

endmodule
</verilog>

reg [3:0] row_addr_reg;
